Nurse Julie is soooo good!! I've been seeing her since 2018 when I was brand new to any type of cosmetic treatments. I've gotten filler & Dysport with her multiple times and I STILL get panicky/paranoid at just about every filler appointment haha thankfully Julie is super talented at calming peoples nerves. You can tell she is an expert in her field and she always has a thorough answer for any question or concern you might have. Additionally, she really really does have an eye for facial aesthetics- she makes sure to give you results that suit YOUR face. Highly recommend!

DONT DO IT! I unfortunately took both of my kids in, my youngest was getting his first haircut.
I should have turned around and walked the other way when I got there and was greeted by candy and toys displayed at kid level. The woman who ended up working with us was courteous, but her work was amateur. After she cut my daughters hair ( which took a quick 10 mins) she started on the 1 1/2 year old. I took a closer look at my daughters hair and saw that it was uneven and jagged-it looked like I could have cut it! I got that sinking feeling, but my son was already in the chair. Well I wish I hadn't hesitated! I look and she proceeds to chop off the curls I specifically asked her not to cut from the back of my sons head. She didn't listen, and when I realized this I asked the stylist to stop what she was doing. To Sit Stills credit, I was not charged...probably because they could tell how disconcerted I was.

I hate to give bad reviews but what I expected was a professional hair cut. What we ended up getting was two hack jobs and a missed opportunity at celebrating that first cut for my son.

Terminal A was a bit intimidating when I first arrived here.  I wasn't sure what I was expecting at all.  It is so fast paced that I had to just go with the flow and wing it at some points.

Signage is a bit misleading and the app that you can use doesn't help much either.  Once I did get it together I found where I needed to go.

Lots of different places to stop if you have time.  Try to get to the train as soon as you can if you have a connecting flight.  Or you can just walk there as well.

Franzetti Jewelers has continued to go above and beyond for both premiere service and high quality work. Since going into Franzetti to get an idea of the style rings my fiance and I wanted, to picking up and sizing our rings we have always felt welcomed and confident with our choice in choosing Franzetti. We browsed around Franzetti for many hours before deciding to purchase our rings. We never felt pressured, and the jewelers were incredibly patient. We were always welcomed in on a first name basis, and always offered chocolate liquor and water. When my ring came in and was a little big Franzetti sized it at no additional cost to us. Franzetti has become our go to Austin jeweler!

I attended the Women's Only Boxing class yesterday and had my ass handed to me...over and over and over. Jump ropes, kettle bells, weight circuit, ring-side push ups and mountain climbers...by the time I actually put on gloves and got into the ring, I was bright red and huffing and puffing like a 400 lb asthmatic. My punches could have been blocked by a kitten.

Today, I'm sitting on my couch...crying at the mere thought of having to move or God forbid, use the bathroom (I don't have the strength to stand back up...don't judge!)

I will be back - because it was the best $15 I've spent in a long time. It's a real workout - using your own body and bringing you to the edge of your limits!

This was my first time ever donating blood. I've got a major fear of needles so, what better way to start the new year than conquering ones fears. So, I went on their website and scheduled an appointment to donate some precious life force. 
The day of the appointment I was super nervous, but all the staff members I came across were super helpful and kind. The donation went great and not even a bruise! If/when I decide to donate again, I will definitely return!

I'm so happy I found Hold My Luggage! We got off of our cruise ship at 8:30 am and our flight home wasn't until 7 pm.  I emailed from the ship a few days before and Constance got back to me right away.  She helped me schedule our pickup and drop off and everything went PERFECTLY! Having our bags held allowed us to relax and go see a movie instead of sitting around the airport all day or trying to figure out how to get around with 9 people and 15 pieces of luggage.  Thank you, thank you, thank you!!!

Dr. Hazan is the magician behind Orlando Oral Implant Center by day, and by night and weekend he and his staff are the hero's behind Orlando's best 24 Hour Emergency Dental service. 

As someone with really strong and mostly healthy teeth, I never thought I would need the services of a 24 hour emergency dentist. I also never thought I'd slip on my kitchen floor and break both front teeth in half and completely off... but it happened. It happened two weeks ago.   

It was almost 10pm on the eve of a weekend and I had no idea what to do.  Would my teeth ever look like they used to? What were my options? How long would I miss work? How could I go about my life without teeth? What do I do and where do I even start?!? 

Thankfully I found the listing for Dr. Hazan's office - The Orlando Implant Center by weekday, and Orlando's best 24 Hour Emergency Dentist by night and weekend, conveniently located off of I4.  

I called the 24 Hour number and immediately received information on when, where, and even how much it would cost, to be seen on Saturday morning at 8:30.  

I barely slept and counted down the hours from midnight to 8am. I showed up on their doorstep sobbing, hiding my mouth and holding the pieces of my front teeth in a bag.  

Dr. Hazan and his staff saw me immediately and within 30 minutes he knew exactly what he needed to do to put me back to normal - On a Saturday at 8:30am! 

I left later that afternoon after a root canal, with one tooth sculpted back to normal and the other with a temporary crown.  I spent Saturday night and Sunday healing, and was back at work on Monday as though nothing happened (albeit a bit sore). 

The Wednesday after my accident, Dr. Hazan called me personally to see how I was doing. We made arrangements for my follow-up / permanent crown appointment and a week later the appointment was confirmed by his Dental Technician - I didn't get her name but she is absolutely one of the sweetest, most compassionate and professional ladies I have ever met. 

Today was that follow-up appointment and my smile is better than it's ever been - better than before my fall.  

Dr. Hazen had the most beautiful crown created for me - his attention to detail and diligence ensured my front teeth, top and bottom, are better for this experience.  

His Dental Hygienist brightened my smile and taught me how to care for my crown.  

His Dental Technician made me smile and laugh and relax when I could do nothing but worry and be afraid.  

I think it goes without saying that Dr. Hazan and his staff will now be my forever-dentist. 

So yes, this is more than a review. It's a story with an amazing - surprising - happy ending.  

Thank you Dr. Hazan - 24 Hour Emergency Dentist, Orlando Oral Implant Center, and my hero!

Based on Yelp's reviews I went with Lachelle's French Inspired Floral and was so glad I did!
I have never had this type of red carpet experience with a floral company! Funny thing - when I would order flowers for our clients, I would secretly wish I could see a picture of what our clients were receiving.  Needless to say I gasped when Lachelle told me she takes pictures of the arrangement and sends it to the purchaser as a courtesy. I was SO excited!! Of course, the arrangement was beautiful as all her photo gallery shows.  She even gave us feedback on our client's response.  It's very clear that Lachelle does this from her heart and it's not just a "Job" but a passion.  Thank You, Lachelle!!

We had a great experience here. My husband and I stopped by in early September to purchase goggles & snorkels for our trip to Hawaii and eventually for scuba when we get certified. Although we had done some research into the gear, we didn't know much about selecting it. The gentleman who helped us was very knowledgeable and low pressure, I think his name was Adrian (?). He told us what we should look for when determining which mask/snorkel to purchase and then let us fiddle with products on our own time. We both happened to select models that were out of stock so Adrian offered us the floor models with free cleaner, defogger, and comfort straps. We were thinking about purchasing fins too but they were a little beyond our budget. Instead of pressuring us, Adrian informed us that we could rent fins in Hawaii for about $19/week and that we could purchase the diving fins later when we're ready to certify. We both appreciated his frank & helpful advice. We'll definitely be going back!

I dropped off my wedding band that had gotten too tight over the last 27 years. The gentlemen Tony whom I dealt with could not have been nicer, carefully examining the ring and determining the appropriate new size. 

Less than a week later the ring was finished. When I picked it up I could not believe what an incredible job he did. It looked sparking new and fit absolutely perfectly.....at a very reasonable price. 

I would not hesitate to recommend Benchcraft to anyone.

I love Zoom care. I made a same day appointment for 8:00 after waking in the middle of the night with abdominal and flank pain. Easy to make an appointment, easy website to navigate. I have been to Zoom care twice and both times had the pleasure of having Laura Gerrity, PA, as my provider. She is excellent. She was efficient and professional both times. Her demeanor was very calm and she did a good job explaining what she felt was wrong with me without using medical jargon that was over my head. I love that I was able to receive the medications that I needed right on the spot. I even received a follow-up call to see how I was doing.  I am a huge fan of Zoom care and a huge fan of Laura!

Sakeena, owner and head cook, is a pleasant, happy soul who's genuinely proud of her Afghani culinary background. This part of town lacking in traditional food from Afghanistan, this restaurant is a great addition to the westside 'burb.

Sakeena offered a complimentary samosa appetizer with potatoes, scallions and cilantro and came with her homemade cilantro sauce. Very good. Hot, the sauce was great; if I'm remembering correctly, it had some spice to it to add the the flavors. 

I settled on #4 - Lamb Tikka Kabob. The dish comes with buttery rice, cooked carrots and raisins. I've only had Afghani food one other place (Cafe Kabul), but it was demolished. Based on my previous, ADDICTIVE, experience with this dish, which I have great memories of, I do wish the carrots and raisins on this dish had some juice/liquid accompanying to give the rice and meat more bold flavor. With that said, this dish was still well prepared and tasty! The lamb chunks were pretty tender and seasoned well. 

I look forward to more stops at Kabob Shack; there were other dishes that caught my eyes! It's always a pleasure to patronize independently owned businesses!

I just received my first box of the season! It's huge.

There are only two of us, so I only order a half-share. Just Wow. Once upon a time, the first box of the season was 'the skimpy box', but apparently that is not the case anymore.

Everyone is so nice at the farm, and the manager is incredibly knowledgeable. The share is pricey(since you pay for it all at once), but I enjoy cheap grocery bills all summer with their help~ so, very much worth it!  I'm looking forward to a summer of CSA goodness! =)

So easy. I had everything that was listed out on the website and was in and out of the office in about 4 minutes. They told me I could come back in 5 days to pick up my passport but told me to check the status online. It was ready in 3 days. Came back and was also in and out. 

*People that work there are very friendly. If you have your paperwork in order you will be just fine. 

**Online it says you must now upload all of your documents prior to your appointment. I couldn't upload my photo but it was not an issue. I did upload everything else.

Starting with Bob the Owner who never answers calls, but will take your money.  He promised me 5 week turn around. It's been 9 weeks. I called to check on install and no one returns my call. A frost is going to begin this weekend. The stone has to be heated to 55 degrees before installation and I guarantee they won't do that. I'll make sure. I see myself going to district court today to file a lawsuit for my money. The mail box is full for voicemail. Not a good indication. I would never recommend this company to anyone. There are other horrible reviews for this business. I didn't see it initially. Shame on me.

I've only ever gotten take out.. but I've gotten it a lot for those out there judging. ;) 

So straight to the food..

I'd pass on the Shanghai noodles. They're pretty bland and for the amount of carbs in that big ol serving you can get, I'm sure we can come up with some other options for you to eat. Some faves of mine are appetizers funny enough (I really need to be more adventurous). The black bean chicken wraps are outstanding even though a hunk of iceberg lettuce can be off putting. Really though? They're delicious and the serving portion is huge if you're getting take out. And the garlic chicken wings are also mighty tasty.. even if they just taste like regular chicken wings. Then again when eating something "garlic" you shouldn't come out of the experience feeling like a dying vampire I guess. 

The staff has always been friendly and the food comes out relatively fast depending on how many people you're picking up for. They've always been helpful when trying to figure out portion stuff, too. Trust me, you might not want to share so make sure you order enough and then some. You'll also want some more a couple hours later.. not just because it's Chinese food. but because it's goooood.

A PLUS +++ CUSTOMER SERVICE!!!  The two guys showed up early to haul off remaining stuff from a duplex demo, but I was caught in Round Rock at IKEA (C minus---customer service) and was quite late getting to the job site.  They were patiently waiting and had the BEST attitude.  And even though my load was slightly over the 1/2 truck limit, they didn't charge any extra!  Now where do you see THAT these days?!?  What a breath of fresh air, even in the garbage business!!  I will definitely use this company again.

I always go to this Bath and Body Works.  I have never had a bad or terrible experience. It is usually busy at this location. All of the employees are always sweet and helpful, recommending things when you ask. They have social distancing precautions and give you hand sanitizer whenever you come into the store to make sure your hands are clean. The last experience I had was a few weeks ago and I bought a few candles. The cashier was very funny and sweet and made me laugh. Nothing incredibly noteworthy about this place but would recommend!

The lack of customer service here is astonishing. The woman at the counter was on the phone when I came in, when I went up to check out 30 minutes later she was still on the phone. She watched me come to the counter, turned her back to me, and started a new line of conversation. I will never return, which is a shame. I used to shop here all the time but it has fallen apart in the last 5 years.

I knew Jeff from wine events he used to have in Southern Oregon so I came and checked out his new wine store here in the big city and it is awesome!  He serves wines by the glass, so you can sip on something he recommends based on your personal tastes while you are shopping! He is very down to earth and has the wines categorized in all sorts of ways (wines for different TV shows, wines for what kind of dog you have...) it is a very welcoming atmosphere in a Cheers sort of way, and he has all kinds of events and classes!

The three employees working when I came in today were completely uninterested in helping me. No one greeted me, the employee closest to me took a phone call instead of helping me (the phone rang after she saw me and after I approached the front counter), and when she asked one of the other two employees to help me, one of them took her sweet old time coming to the front counter. When she did, she would not look at me or make eye contact and very rudely told me to walk over to a different counter. She was so unfriendly and projected a terrible, mean attitude for absolutely no reason. My mere presence seemed to have offended her. Yikes. People who behave like that for no reason clearly have issues.

I will never use this location again. The set of employees I encountered were incredibly rude and bored. I will take my business elsewhere.

Also--notice how the only good reviews are from people in NY and not even locals? Makes you wonder who's getting paid to amp up the overall rating of this place! It is horrible!

I live in Chicago and  infrequently windermere. we own several old themed venue facilities in Chicago. Orlando Estate Auction is our go to auction for accessory items and fixtures . Because it is a true estate auction we have been able to purchase unique  yet quality items.  The inventory varies from modern to estate antique, with a plethera of the unique.
this auction is fast moving and quite enjoyable. The owners have made  my absentee bids easy, and of course my on site bids fun.
Rick Nowak

WOWOWOWOWOWOW

My Macbook Pro died on Monday and I was in a panic. Usual repairman couldn't fit me in til late Wednesday and told me by the description I shared that the laptop was basically useless. On Wednesday I got a 2nd opinion by calling MacDoctors. WOW. (1) free advice from Alan immediately via call and text; (2) appointment Thursday morning 10 AM; (3) instructions on how to back up everything in anticipation of replacing the harddrive; (4) HE COMES TO YOU at no extra charge; (5) the guy is a GENIUS, plus he's super focused and never made me feel like a dummy for some of the (likely dumb) questions I had. If you have a Mac problem you need to call Alan. I will NEVER use another tech again.

The good, the bad, and the ugly. The good: Justin the tow truck driver was exceptionally nice. Went out of his way to help me. The employees at shop were pleasant and helpful. The bad: I was going to have it towed to a dealer. When I was looking online. It showed C&L as a AAA repair service. So instead of the dealer, just had it to right to C&L. Next morning I get a call that it was indeed the starter. I contacted my warranty Company, the repair was approved by them for C&L to do the work. Also it took 90 minutes for the tow to get to me. C&L is a little bit over 3 miles away. The Ugly: The "Boss" had his service counter call me to say that he would not honor the warrant. I had the warranty company on the phone. They wanted to explain the process and they get paid immediately by credit card. It's a highly rated warranty company. I was told the "Boss" was out of town until Monday. The lady went out into the shop to ask someone about doing the repair under the warranty. Answer was still no. In a nutshell, the "Boss" is real jerk. I am pretty much sure he was actually there, but couldn't prove it. Would not call the warranty company directly, made no attempt to talk to me. This was all while I was actually at C&L. Even in the beginning. I had to call the warranty although it clearly shows that the repair shop is supposed to call to get the authorization. I had to do their job. That being said, when I told them it was an after market warranty in the beginning, being ethical and telling right from the start that they wouldn't honor it. I knew it was the starter because everything else was good. Yet they did a diagnostic and it cost me $105 just for that. Thief. With my warranty I have a "no deductible" that would have paid that. This "Boss" knew what he was doing. Fraudulent at the least. Now I'm waiting on a tow to get it to Pep Boys. Pep Boys pays the first $50 on the tow and they do honor my warranty. Actually they have a fleet contract with the warranty company. If you value your hard earned money, stay away from this place. Will never get another dime from me, and he shouldn't get your dime either. If the "Boss" had half the amount of care as the employees, it still wouldn't care. If I ever need a tow again in the area, I will make certain AAA doesn't this place to get me.

Found this by chance, and I'm glad I did.  I haven't been in a game store in many years, but lately I've been wanting to get a Wii or Xbox to use while working out.  Something I can actually do, at home, instead of finding excuses not to go to the gym in the winter.

I was nearby looking for a restaurant and saw this, so I popped in and explained what I wanted. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, and explained my options (mainly confirming my research.)  They set me up with a used system at a very reasonable price, including everything I need.  

I'll be back if I need more games, etc.  They have some LPs, many games, movies, locally-made coasters with video game themes, and lots more.  I'm happy to support a local place, especially when they're better than any chain to boot.

If your sales rep is an older, tall male with a birth mark on his forehead, you might as well walk out of the store now.

My husband needed a suit for a wedding so we went to the Easton store because I was told that out of all of the Men's Warehouse locations in the area, Easton had the most retail inventory.  We walked in and the sales rep (the guy with the birthmark) just looked at us and did not say anything.  The front desk girl was great and greeted us and directed us to the suit section.  Then the sales rep approached us with no hello or anything and said that he would measure my husband.  

Through just these two minutes of encounter, you can just see that he did not want to help us.  I told him exactly what we wanted and kept showing us the items that was OPPOSITE of what I was looking for.  

Not only that, he was very rude and had a smart mouth all around.  My husband got fitted for a shirt and he said that it was too tight around his neck.  The guy said "no, it's not. It's big on you and it's fine"  Or if my husband didn't like the certain style he had on and he voiced what he didn't like about it, then he would scoff at my husband and said "well, that's how suits are supposed to be like"  I'm pretty sure suits are not supposed to be sitting mid-thigh flared out like you are wearing your dad's suit as a 10 year old.  

My super patient husband that never complains about bad service got so upset with his demeanor and rude attitude was getting upset.  This guy picked on EVERY LITTLE THING that my husband was saying to him! 

Why would I want to spend $800 for my husband with a sales rep that is being a complete ahole?  We finally had our last straw of patience and left.  We then went to the Tuttle Crossing location and seriously had a night and day experience.  So please, if you plan to be spending money on a suit, stay away from this location, especially if you get the same person that we did!

Saw the great reviews and felt obligated to pick up some bubble tea before leaving Vancouver. Showed up, ordered two things and mine was average and wayyyy too sweet. Couldn't and didn't want to finish it. Also got those bubble things-- super moist and flat on the texture end and below average taste. Really really not impressed by this place. Oh and to top it off it took way too long to get our food and drinks. There were literally two other customers waiting for orders yet we were stuck there for 15+ minutes.

This so called agency is out to get your money. They are completely unprofessional and have refused to respond to my phone calls and emails. The company owes me money for head shots that were not printed. The one response I received stated I was going to get my money refunded. Once I followed through with another email I was given no reply. Do not sign here. If you are looking for a talent agency I suggest going to a more populous city such as Dallas or Houston.

They came out and spent at least an hour looking at fixing some of our existing deck issues and to figure out what it would take to build another raised deck. Waited 3 weeks for a quote and was wondering why we hadn't heard anything. Called them and the person said "I talked to my boss and he said its not a job we are capable of taking on". 

It would have been nice if they had the courtesy to let us know this rather than waiting for no reason.

Good thing the arcade is clean because even though they don't close until 10pm, you cannot rent a preview room if you get there at 7:17pm - never mind that the store in Tigard sent us there. 
Makes no sense but was told 'well, if you guys don't want to leave right away and we had to get you out"  really?  
Well we were finished in time for me to write a scathing review before 8pm! 
I'm sorry but whomever manages that store is an idiot. Do not go to this location ever. Stupid people who make up  nonsense rules for their convenience.  Customers do not matter here.

We had the Lad Na, Ba Boong, Yum Woon Sen and Pad Phirk Khing. 
All were very good! 
Lad Na- wide noodles with a delicious brown gravy sauce, choose any meat you like
Ba Boong- we never had this dish before and it was surprising good. The noodle is covered in a creamy coconut sauce and you have to mix in the fish sauce, peanut and chili in yourself. Top with tons of veggie and a spring roll which adds interesting texture/flavor. SO GOOD! 
Yum Woon Sen- sour and spicy goodness! 
Pad Phrik Khing- crispy beans with beef (your choice of meat) 

Spice level goes from 1 to 12(or was it 10), I don't usually eat spicy so 3 was good, 5 is where I start feeling the spice but can still handle it. 

Definitely worth the drive!

I have been a dedicated customer of Borrowlenses for nearly 5 years, maybe more I've lost count! They have been accommodating every time. I never incur random fees, they've even stayed a bit later at HQ in Waltham for me. My only wish is that customers who've been with them for years should get some kind of special discount and I wish they weren't so far and changed the pricing to pick up in the city. It is really DIFFICULT getting to WALTHAM FROM BOSTON WHEN WORKING A 9-5 But I wouldn't go anywhere else! It's the most affordable to rent and great gear!

Did a search for "mashed potatoes" on Yelp and found this little gem! The service was fantastic - our waitress didn't hover but she was there when we needed her. I ordered the crab cakes (with a side of mashed potatoes, yum!) and my mom got the NY Strip steak. The food was great, reasonably priced, and drinks were good too. I want to go back to participate in pub quiz nights on Mondays. 

There are 2 reasons I didn't give it 5 stars:

1.) the music was really loud and wasn't conducive to having a dinner conversation. 
2.) there was a homeless guy in the bar area yelling profanities at the top of his lungs. He was apparently known to the staff because they didn't kick him out. It was a mood killer (and frankly a bit alarming at first).

Really amazing place, there are two levels with a great variety of games.  It also has a rollercoaster, drop zone and bumper cars.  I liked that it was so open and light. There's a bar on each level.  Try the chocolate martini, you won't be disappointed ! It's easy to get a ticket either at the front desk or the kiosk.  It's literally fun for the whole family.  In addition it's very easy to maneuver a wheelchair.  We all had a great time!

It's a counter inside the bustle of Peachtree Center. The 2 women at the counter were very friendly! So, the food is decent. I got to sample the sausage roll which is actually quite tasty. The pastry is flavorful and flaky and the sausage is well seasoned and tasty. Buuut that's not what I ordered. So, the Jamaican Beef Patty Is not exactly that. The crust is a good consistency, but is lacking flavor. The beef is seasoned well and tastes good, but this patty is less Jamaican and more Indian samosa with regards to the flavor. The chicken and bacon was pretty good. Think chicken pot pie with not many veggies in a hand pie, they're genius! Lastly, the Apple pie. Not a fan. Again the crust is lacking flavor, but the Apple filling has good flavor. It's a bit dry, but some people like that so, I get it. If you're a juicy Apple pie lover, like you like your apples in a hut of a sugary buttery sauce, this isn't the one for you. The texture of the crust could also use some work. I will return, but to taste other savory pies.

I have been in martial arts for most of my life.  My family even owns a Tae Kwon Do school.  In all of my nearly 20 years involved in martial arts, both as a student and from a business standpoint, I have never been to a school this good.

The instructor, Professor Dande (pronounced "Dun-jee"), is the kindest, most humblest instructor I have ever met.  Not only is he certified BAMF (I believe he's ranked #4 in the world at his weight), but he gives great, clear instruction, along with practical examples.  He seems to honestly care for his students.

I have only been here for 6 weeks (it's weird to be a complete beginner again after doing martial arts my whole life), but I'm completely hooked.  Come roll with us!

This company is complete garbage.  We moved out the rental property 6 months ago and continue to get billed. We complied with their cancellation policy and have wrote 3 times. The first 2 were sent certified then Chris tells me they font accept certified letters for cancellation. The 3rd letter he say he never received which is a complete lie as he called me the day he received it and said I still had to pay for the other periods since the certified letters was not a proper way for cancellation. I paid the balance to get them out my hair and now I continue to receive bills from them. I'm filing a better business bureau report and have wrote the the Georgia Attorney General office.

Jillian's Inclusive Childbirth Class was exceptional and just the preparation we needed to feel confident, informed, and at peace before our labor & delivery experience. Jillian is engaging in her presentation and a wealth of knowledge about all things childbirth. She gave well-rounded, non-directive answers and information, encouraging each mom/couple to prepare and make the decisions right for our families. The 6-hour (9 AM - 3 PM) class went much quicker than I expected, with plenty of breaks and interactive elements to keep our attention (along with freedom to get comfortable & move around for all the pregnant mamas!). After finishing Jillian's class, I can truly say I feel optimistic and excited toward the labor and delivery experience, rather than the overwhelmed and terrified feelings I was expecting. Jillian effectively empowers mothers and families toward healthy, hopeful childbirth, and I am so thankful for her willingness to share her experiences and insights with us.

Please save your money!  There a million ways to try to find a great person, but Single Atlanta is not one of them.

I have been a client and have spoken to a number of others, who have been clients of this company.  The company makes promises of a professional team making hand- selected matches, but the reality is that they have very few male clients to send on any dates. The dates they did set-up were not close to what I was looking for, but since the owner spent only 15 minutes talking about me, it should not have been surprising.  The initial interview consisted of one of the owners telling me for 90 minutes about the company (known as a sales pitch) and making no further contact.  The only "relationship" they make is with the money they collect.  

I wish I could have donated my money to anyone other than these disreputable owners.

Peter and his team are exceptional. I can't say enough positive things about Hawkeye inspectors. Waking up bright and early on a Saturday morning for a home inspection, I was prepared to be in for a long day...

Boy was I pleasantly surprised. Peter and his colleague were extremely patient with our questions and meticulous in their inspection of the house.  They were also kind enough to bring snacks and drinks for everyone. 

Peter also has a great sense of humor and had me laughing throughout the inspection - making the process not only extremely informative, but fun at the same time!

Being a first time homebuyer, I learned so much during the inspection and would not hesitate to use Hawkeye inspectors in the future.

We have been here on 4 occasions. The first visit, very impressed, they have done some cool things to the interior.....love all of the details. Our waitress was super friendly, she explained they hadn't been open for long and she frequently had to ask someone for help with questions we had about the beer......totally ok, she was sweet and energetic. The last 3 visits.....REALLY HORRIBLE!! I have never had such unbelievably rude service, the waitress acted like it was an ENORMOUS imposition to tell the 13 year old child with us what non alcoholic beverages they served!! We ordered a pretzel and it was ok, the beer is ok but really why would I want to spend money in a place that employs such rude people?! Also, when we went last night......it was crazy hot inside!

Worst customer service by far. I came in with some questions about gymnastics and dance for my two daughters. The lady.. or lady's at the front desk were absolutely not interested in helping me out at all. Very short. Un answered questions and were just plain out rude. They were more interested in filling lip gloss boxes and talking about how cute the lip glosses were?!? Wtf. Wanted to give them a chance but the un welcoming feeling quickly changed my opinion on them. Have herd great things about the director. Needs better staff.

MmmMm... Wish I didn't have to rush out of here from lunch to get where I was going bc this food was deee-lish.  It tasted great even after.  Had El Sombrero which was an enchilada and fajoita served with a side of rice, beans and guac.  Had a side of sangria and this frozen drink thats sangria and margarita mixed 2gether.  Nxt time I'll stick to just da sangria.  EXTREMELY busy during lunch time so phone ahead for takeouts if you can.

WARNING - BAIT AND SWITCH

This company solicited our business with an offer for an outside awning in the range of $4,000. By the time we got the contract, it had gone up to $6,200. We were told that this was all-inclusive. Today, months later, the awning arrived. Because of its size, the UPS driver couldn't unload it by himself. I called Sunsetter to find out where the installation crew was and they said that the price did not include installation - even though we had discussed installation logistics at length when I placed the order.

We are cancelling the order and learning from our experience.

My experience with AHF has been positive overall, and the results speak for themselves. I came to AHF/Jeremy after being sidelined by an injury, resulting in weight gain and overall poor health. I'm still on the journey (and will update the review/ratings when I reach my ultimate goal), but as for now, I feel much better, I've lost weight, and I've even experienced some random and unexpected positive outcomes: I see and hear better, my hair is thicker, and my chronic tinnitus is gone. Who knew?! As much as I complain to Jeremy about continually posting photos of my meals, I have to admit it's been really helpful in terms of accountability, and also in terms of  seeing what others are eating. I did experience some confusion in the beginning, as the online program content doesn't necessarily match Jeremy's, but I believe(?) he is in the process of updating all of those materials, so hopefully that will be remedied soon. I didn't choose to take any of the supplements, partly because I really wanted to do this using food only, and partly because they cost even more money -- and my results were still extremely positive. Overall, I've developed healthy new habits, and look forward to continued progress.

I went to The Gun Room for Archery Supplies. Upstairs is a fair selection of Archery Supplies. Not a wide variety but a good assortment. It's more like a store room of supplies than a store. If you can look past the clutter and get past the large amount of info given on why they only carry certain brands. You may find what you need. I only wanted Nocks. I even showed the sales rep. the arrow I needed a Nock for. He said, You need this one. I buy a Dozen for $4.00. Awesome...... Till I got home to discover. I had in fact NOT been given the correct Nocks. They do sell Free Standing Bag/Targets for cheaper than any other place in town. 

So I say, Buyer Beware. You may or may not get what you need.

This service was a waste of time. I was looking for help refreshing my resume and LinkedIn profile. I was assigned a resume writer who spent maybe 10 minutes asking me questions before updating my resume (I had a solid, up to date version to start with). The first draft was ok and Deb turned it around quickly. However, she was not open to any of my feedback or edits. She just kept telling me that what she had created was "exactly as it should be". I figured she had gotten it to a place that I could tweak it further on my own. Once the resume was done, they would work on my LinkedIn profile. I was expecting they would use the resume as a guide so the information is consistent, but all they did was cut and paste exact text. I could have done that myself! I am extremely disappointed in this service and would not recommend having them work on your LinkedIn profile at all. I gave them 2 stars because they were timely and customer service was good...until I let them know I was dissatisfied with the final product. I have yet to hear back from that email.

I went back and forth for about 3months on whether or not to share my experience with Mr Trumpler. After alot of thought i decided i wouldn't wish my experience with this guy on anybody. I had a resisting arrest case in comal county and i was referred to him by a friend. My case was handled as a joke by him from the start to finish. Near the end of it i found out that he broke privilege by sharing my arrest video with the friend that referred me and from what i gather it could only be to try and make mockery of my situation and share a laugh about my case. I've never had such a poor experience with a lawyer in my life. And will be on probation with from what i can tell the maximum amount of punishment during the course of it with about $1000 in classes alone not to mention my community service and fines associated with the court and probation totally around $1800. I would not recommend this guy to anyone.

The following events all took place in one night:

1) John R. held Scott B. up in a stadium packed with thousands of their feisty, screaming fans... clearly hungry for more!

2) Shannon F. and Scott B. were caught by the paparazi moonlighting in a foreign city, under the light of the PBR TallBoy Building.

3) Shannon F. and Jennie B. were caught on a date (on the same night)... (under the light of the same building)... (ho...)

4)  The Gay Yelpers were snapped in a photo shoot for the covers of both People AND Sports Illustrated Magazines!

So, a lot more pictures were taken... and they were all free.

Total Entertainment is a company that will come to your event and provide various computer-based backgrounds for pictures taken on the spot in front of a green screen.  They curtail the products offered to the needs of your event.  

For the attendees of the event -- the pictures were free... (i'm sure the loot was dished out at some point for this service -- but it sure made Pabst look good)

Check 'em out -- friendly and willing to put up with all of our drunk yelper asses...

Our little boy has been at the new Pond Springs location since September, right after they opened.  He is making great progress!  The staff at this location is wonderful, and I feel like our son is very well cared for.  They are genuinely excited when he achieves milestones, and will send me updates during the day if something significant happens. I love the random videos and pictures I receive, and reading in his daily journal from each of his therapists.  Most of all, I love that my son LOVES to go to his "school"!  He giggles every time we drive up.  We are so grateful to have found ABC.

La Provence is definitely a popular breakfast spot among Portlanders and for good reason.  I've been more times than I can remember.  This location doesn't seem as crowded as the other two, but expect a wait on weekends.

Their bakery section is top notch and with reasonable prices.

The menu is a cross between simple timeless favorites and the eclectic, but they don't take the latter too far.  There's omelettes, hashes, and French Toast, but all with elevated Ingredients and slight variations.

Today, I opted for the Monte Cristo sandwich.  It's fully coated in egg batter and (I believe) deep fried, which is becoming much harder to find in a health conscious era.  But of course there's the usual Portland twist as it also includes pineapple.  Still, a solid sandwich.  

The Croissants look like they're on steroids, so there's value to many items.

My friend's salmon salad looked like a perfect satisfaction if you're craving a heart-friendly meal.  The crab omelette looked tasty.

Thankfully, the cappuccino was served in the appropriate sized cup and not something that resembling a soup bowl.

Service was super friendly and fast given the size of the crowd.  The manager/hostess guy was cool.  They rope off a section of the private parking lot which is a slight bummer, but there's usually enough street parking within one block.

We hired Paul to refinish the existing hardwood floors in our house and to install new hardwood in our living room.  He gave us a very reasonable quote on the work and the finished product turned out looking great!  He's a one man show, so it took a little longer than a company with a team of people, but his workmanship was good, always returned phone calls and the end result was fantastic.  He let himself in and out of the house, and is trustworthy.  There was a bit of wood dust left on counters and window sills, but that comes with the territory I guess.  Easy to deal with  and I'd recommend Paul to anyone.

I would not give Dogma a star. I asked for a tour on a Sunday afternoon and a nice woman showed the kennel area and nice suites for dogs. We were walking down a hall and I peeked in the door window of the large dog area. A young man was dragging a gray dog kicking it and hanging the dog by its neck up with a leash. He took the poor dog and slammed it in a kennel. This was so upsetting I can not get this out of my head. At the time I ask the woman PLEASE make him stop hurting the dog. She told me nobody really cares and the owner only wants your MONEY.  She walked me out of the building at Dogma and told me to keep my mouth shut.  PLEASE be careful if you leave your dog. I also found out from a friend that Dogma has a problem with dog fights because they let dangerous types of dogs play. This has made me decide I will never board my dogs. My Vet has recommended a home care person to take care of the dogs.

My boyfriend and I took one of the 2-hour tours and we were lucky to be the only ones registered (probably because it was during the hottest part of the day). Wes was our guide and he really catered the tour to us since we are locals and already know a lot about the city. However, he had several fun facts (which I love) and also showed us some cool secret spots which really made this tour unique. He was super friendly and the tour itself was slow paced, which I appreciated because I'm not the fastest or skilled on a bike. I liked the bike a lot too; the seat was uncomfortable towards the end but I've never met a comfortable bike seat. Overall I would definitely recommend! Would be especially fun for out-of-towners!

Please don't do yourself a disservice by believing any negative reviews...this ENT doctor is the best in the field! Dr Gopal has been my sinus doctor for 30 years, dealing with various issues over these many years. I've most admired his conservative approach, carefully monitoring my situation until I finally implored him to do surgery because I couldn't breathe...I'd reached the end of the line. I had my surgery in June and I've never--at anytime in my adult life--felt better. My quality of life has greatly improved: I'm able to sleep again without constantly waking to blow my nose or struggle for breath and my asthma has been eased.

Dr Gopal is an excellent surgeon. He prepared me very well for all aspects of my surgery and after-care with careful follow-ups and was gentle, kind and informative throughout the process. I had complete confidence in his expert abilities and it was well-founded; he did a superb job and I am so grateful. My only fear is that he may retire someday!

Motorcycle shop on steroids. Used to have a Kmart feel to it...And I'm not just saying that because it's in an old Kmart building. Product selection and merchandising is much better than it was a few years ago. It truly is a motorcycle superstore. If you haven't been in for awhile, go back and check it out... They've seriously stepped up the game. 

Only negative is the layout of the front doors / security guard situation. They should call a door repair person and get the front doors serviced. Security guard should get out of the chair and be more active rather than just looking at everyone like they stole something. They should clean up the layout / flow of the entrance / exit. This would also minimize theft which you can tell they are worried about.

My recent experience was great, got two new tires for my motorcycle. Price was good / comparable to what you could find online. People at the parts area are great. 

Worth noting is that these guys seem to do a good job managing the categories and price points. Whether you're shopping for a new motorcycle, new accessory, or parts...These guys have selection and options in all price ranges. This is great because you can go get something without being gauged to death.

Maverick Horseback Riding offers the quintessential Texas trail riding experience! Most importantly to me, the horses (and all other animals on property) are in pristine condition and the owner related to us how the horses receive excellent hoof care, chiropractors as needed, and are all around well cared for. 
The trail riding experience starts with meeting the horse on the ground and grooming and saddling them. This gives the rider a chance to bond with the horse before heading to the open terrain. Many horses are ridden in hackamores (no bit), but some have a bit as needed. Horses are tacked in western gear, but neck-reining knowledge is not needed as the horses respond to English-style queues. The owner emphasizes the importance of posture in the saddle, and how the rider's movements alter the horse's behavior. The trail ride encompasses gorgeous views and the chance for more experienced riders to trot and canter.
Highly recommend!

NEVER EVER EVER USE THIS PLACE.  Came back after a week to a sticky van, with a handful of claim tickets from other customers in the console, the back seat of the van was soaked like someone left a window open during a storm. When we left the windows were up and the van was locked. My understanding was that you leave the car with them for safe keeping, not for them to use. I will never recommend this business to anyone nor would I ever use them again. Very shady business!!!! AVOID AVOID AVOID!!!!!

Manager hires auto technicians with no experience in installing a hitch and fires employee the same day. We had an 8:30am appointment with U-Haul to drop our Grand Caravan to have hitch put on and was told by Patricia the hitch would take only an hour to install. We stayed close by and ran errands with family in tow and called to follow up  2 hours later and was told the van was still not ready and they would call me shortly. We ended up running more errands and ate  lunch nearby waiting for a phone call from Uhaul, and never received a phone call.  After lunch, we drove over to U-Haul (5 hours later) and the van was still not ready! The manager at Uhaul, Ed Hollins was installing our hitch when he realized his employee had not idea what he was doing.  Ed told my husband that the employee who attempted to install our hitch was in training and was new. He also stated that he was firing him. Ed took our vehicle for a drive and something didn't feel right. Manager Ed admitted to breaking the leaf springs when the hitch was installed. He did not realize the hitch installs where the leaf springs are located. Ed unbolted the leaf springs and could not put them back on. He advised us to bring our van elsewhere to repair the damages and install the hitch properly. My husband requested a reimbursement after in the amount of $128. So, six hours later and still no hitch installed and our van has damages done by Uhaul. Ed told us we need to get the car repaired somewhere and the hitch installed and he would pay for the damages that he caused. We made some phone calls to locate a place close by to install the hitch properly and fix the leaf springs which the U-Haul employee broke. Tire Kingdom located in Sanford took another 2 hours to get to our van, but they installed the hitch within 30 minutes and repaired our vehicle.  So an entire day ( 9.5 hours to get the hitch installed properly and it wasn't even done by Uhaul. My husband was told at the tire place Uhaul staff bent our hitch frame and threaded a bolt.  We scheduled another day with Manager Ed at Uhaul to put a new bolt on our vehicle because the one that came with the hitch was threaded off. This has now become a safety issue. Ed schedule another day for us to drop our van off. After 24 hours we pick up the van and look at the work that was done and E's auto technician did a shady job using a white compound glue to seal a black piece of plastic with a dummy bold attached to the end to appear that a new bolt was replaced. My husband called Ed to tell him what his technician did and we also put in a complaint with Uhaul's corporate office. This place is scam and they do not know what they are doing. Ed hires employee without experience and has made this whole experience a hassle. They should hire a new manager who knows what they are doing.

The movie(s) (we saw a double feature) was great and totally fun to go to the drive-in. About 7 food trailers next door for food. And I would definetely go again - especially in the summer, when we can sit outside. 

The 'specials' however, were extremely over-priced. The extra $25 for the valentine's snacks consisted of 2 ziplocs of popcorn, some more butter popcorn, 2 cans of soda, a rose and a handful of willy wonka candy. 

That was definetely not worth it, but I would go back and next time just bring my own snacks - that's the whole point of the drive-in anyway, right?

This place should be embarrassed. I ordered their sweet and sour chicken today, but that's not what I ate. I ate straight up sweet and sour breading. I had to double check that I actually ordered chicken before I wrote this review because I don't think I had a single piece of chicken in my meal. And yes. That picture is not photoshopped. Their sauce is actually bright pink. But I will give credit by saying their sauce didn't really taste as artificial as it looks and the veggies were rather fresh, especially for Chinatown.

I'll give them a star for their atmosphere as it is rather clean and well-kept and the server was nice. But in terms of food...laughable at best. If you come here either leave or at least don't order anything fried. Try something else. Unless you want to leave hangry. Like I did.

Nice people, crappy work. Their "100% satisfaction guarantee" is a little hollow when they won't return phone calls or email after a subpar project. As their own site notes, "There is a lot of competition for refinishing in Portland and Vancouver," so do yourself a favor use someone else, someone competent. These folks don't deserve your business.

Edit: May, 2017: Renew-it got in touch. and they will be repairing the tub finish this summer (my schedule doesn't allow until then), so I've upped this to three stars for making the effort. As soon as the work is completed, assuming it's the quality I both expect and they promise, I'll revise again.

Kent did a fantastic job of repairing my chimney and the flashing! He also was the only chimney expert who noticed a problem with the exhaust pipe from my furnace (I had five different pros look at it). Turns out none of the exhaust from my gas furnace was getting out of my house. Thanks to Kent we're now safe and the chimney looks and works great! Kent is incredibly professional and has immense knowledge! To this first time home buyer he taught me tons, and I'm forever grateful to him for his patience, expertise and great conversations!

Embassy Enterprises is hands down the best. Last summer I started getting bids to teardown our old fence and build a new one. We met with a couple of fence companies that were mostly apathetic and gave us high bids for basic fence designs. Then we were referred to Jason at Embassy Enterprises. From the start Jason was so positive and excited about our ideas and really worked with us to make our dream fence a reality. It was instantly evident that Jason loves his work and takes the quality of what he makes seriously. Not only that but he was the best bid!

Needless to say, we went with Jason and the crew at Embassy. We could not be happier. The teardown of the old fence and construction of the new fence went great with excellent communication as the project progressed. Since completion, Jason has checked up on the fence without prompting and has diligently and generously replaced any slightly warped boards and adjusted anything that needed it - without us even asking. On top of all of that, the fence is so handsome that neighbors we don't even know have stopped their car and come up to our house to ask who built our fence.

Simply put, you won't find a better or nicer person to work with.

I went in to choose a simple carpet runner for my staircase. The salesperson was quick to help me choose a carpet and take 1/2 down. He said he'd set up for measurements, binding and installation. There was no up-front price for install, I thought it was included in the overall price. After taking 1/2 down I never heard back. I called the store and was told the installer would be getting ahold of me to measure. He called and said he had my carpet, it was bound and he was ready to install. I questioned the measurements and again had to call the salesperson at which time he apologized and said there was a mix up and the installer will be calling me again to set up measurements. He came to my house to measure and looked at my staircase and said, "I'll do it for $375." I was never told about an additional cost for instillation and it seemed as though he just threw out a number. I heard nothing back for a couple days. I called the salesperson  and he said the installer forgot to measure the width of the stairs! He asked me to measure it and took another $300 down in order to move forward to have it bound. I heard nothing for over 2 weeks and called the salesperson to see if the carpet was done. He apologized and said it had been done for awhile and that he "dropped the ball." Since then the installer has failed to show 4 times. I called the salesperson on the 3rd time and he apologized saying "I'll make this right." Now the 4th time, no call, no show. I'm hoping to cancel or dispute payment. I don't think at this point I would trust them to install or deal with any other issues if they were to arise after instillation. I have dealt with a lot of contractors and done a lot of home improvements and this is by far the worst experience I've had, and the first review I've ever written. Please don't waste your time and money with these people. It's been almost 2 months since my initial payment.

Tried to visit today. It was 5:50 and the door was locked. Closing time posted was 6:00pm There were people inside too. Business hours are the most basic thing you can hold standards to. Fail. My kids were looking forward to trying your treats too. You've just lost customers and we won't be back. Plenty of other yummy dessert places in the Heights that do hold true to their business hours.

Edited to add my response back to the business owner who contacted me: 

We visited exactly one week ago. Also- my concern wasn't that people were locked inside. More to point out that you were still serving customers. If your door is heavy/ sticky you should put up a sign saying that. Also- an employee saw us try to open the door and made no attempt to help or waive us in. And finally- chairs were already on tables and floor cleaning had commenced. It was clear that you were trying to close early.

I've had eyelash extensions done several times by a few different people. Jaime at Fluttery Lash Design is unequivocally the best. Let me break it down for you...

The studio. 
It's clean and comfortable. Both of which are deal breakers for me. Jamie goes above and beyond comfort by providing a blanket and keeps the room temp to whatever feels best for the client. 

Quality of material & technique
It's clear that Jamie takes a lot of pride in the type of lashes, glue, etc she uses to make sure you look and feel amazing and that your natural lashes are well cared for. Jamie has a very gentle hand in how she applies lash extensions. You could totally fall asleep during a session, if that's what you're feeling. 

Also, Jamie is one of those people that can connect with just about anyone. She's down to earth and genuinely cares about people. First time I was there I felt like I'd made a new friend. When you spend a couple hours every few weeks with a person, that matters. 

Overall, I've always been 100% satisfied with my eyelash extensions done by Jamie. If you're looking for high quality lashes, Jamie is your girl.

My favorite CentraCare in all of Central Florida! I used to live in Metrowest but moved to SODO recently. My husband and I were feeling sick. We were run down, congested and worried about the possibility of Covid so we made appointments online and were seen right on time! The staff and provider, Danielle Fravel were all wonderful! Compassionate, friendly and efficient.  I am always nervous about seeing doctors at urgent care centers but everyone here made us feel cared for and safe, too! They offer rapid Covid testing and we got our negative results in 15 minutes, so tHey sent us home with instructions to help us get over our colds.  Great positive experience!  Excellent service!

As a woman who just turned 60 I'm very interested in optimal fitness to help me maintain my active lifestyle of back packing and cycling.  I am very happy with the options at Lloyd Athletic Club.  Between the classes, the equipment and the personal training, I have actually never been in better condition.  I'd been doing my own thing with weights and the cardio machines when an on site personal trainer, Mike Ceja, let me know that there was potential for injury with what I was doing.  I went on to have him create a routine for me which I thought I'd do for a month at most, but after that time, I felt considerably stronger with no aches or pains and was hooked!  While we have some good laughs while working together, Mike is a consummate fitness pro, helping me to meet my goals of toning, strengthening and looking pretty darn good for an old gal.

This is my 200th Yelp Review!!

I came here with a group of girls.  We were seated by ourselves at a round table amongst a sea of people in the basement of Elephant and Castle.  From the moment I walked in, I started laughing.  I walked in with a friend who is not a Yelper, and had no idea what to expect.  I love the high school reunion theme and how everyone stays in character the whole time.  The one actor is a supposed software company CEO and my friend was asking him technical questions the entire time to try and get him to get out of character.  It was entertaining.

The actors are also the servers.  I give them some serious props for getting everything out on time and with a good attitude.  The food was very good.  The roast chicken was delicious and a huge portion!  I honestly have no complaints about the food.  They will even box it up for you if you have leftovers, and they can accommodate people with specific food allergies. 

I'm going to be honest. You need to go in with the right expectations.  It's a like goofy/cheesy/whatever, but if you just go with it, you will have a good time.  People are too grumpy sometimes!  I feel bad for them.

We have been to the Rodeo before, this was our first tour with a a school group... and it was great fun.

Each school group was greeted by their own personal tour guide that helped keep our students on time, and moving from activity to activity.

The parent with the lunches was met in the parking lot with a helpful Rodeo person who   made sure I lunches were at our assigned location for lunch.

Activities were terrific for pint-sized attention spans:  petting zoo, "Mustang Makeover" (who had the students entranced, and encouraged (um endured?) a lot of questions, baby chicks, Texas Longhorn, live Texas music (got the wiggles out!), then off to the Pig races....

Somehow we caught a few minutes of a dog frisbee trick show, a big hit with the kids.

Great fun, and just the right amount for little feet.

Thank you, and see you next year!

(Also, we joined the Kids CLub this year, and it was a deal.  In exchange for our donation we joined the club, got 2 general admissions, a t shirt and a membership card.)

An unforgettable tour. 
Here it is in a nutshell:
Anthony is probably one of the last remaining peoplewho grew up in the North End and can give you a true picture of what it used to be like when it was an almost all Italian neighborhood.
He takes you around to meet some of the shopkeepers who grew up in the neighborhood.
Variety of different kinds of shops, the tour keeps moving but you get a flavor for each, as well as plenty of delicious nibbles along the way.
It is a hearty eating experience, with plenty of good food, culminating with dinner at Anthony's Ma's house. People were so full, they were turning away second and thirds, the food was plentiful.
Anthony is quite a character, and you get to know him as the day progresses. He's very funny! He loves to answer your questions and expand upon what he knows, and is very witty in the moment.

Just got back from Cozumel on a dive trip with Columbus Scuba.  This is our third dive trip with Columbus Scuba and like the other ones it was fantastic.  My wife and I love the family atmosphere at Columbus Scuba and this extends to their trips as well.  We have made quite a few new friends on these trips and at the events at the shop.  I suppose I should add the beautiful sea life we saw on our dives.  

See you on our next trip!!!

My favorite sellwood area bar spot. The happy hour here is pretty reasonable. The service is usually pretty good. The beers are Lompoc which aren't the worst in town by any means. The seating area is warm and cozy which means if they are even remotely busy, their 35 seat capacity feels like a crowded bus. On the quite nights though this works out great for a casual beer and some conversation. They do have a small bar seating area that is cool if you want to sit next to the locals and gab with the bar tenders. The food offerings are certainly above average for bar food though they still are mostly the bar staples: fried or sandwhich. I have had a few instances where I have been completely ignored in an empty restaurant for 30 minutes so that is why they don't get 5 stars.

OMG... walking into this salt haven of magical and unique flavors is amazing. I tried the lemon flake salt, and the black truffle salt, and I loved them all. There is so much to choose from that I couldn't make up my mind, but I did buy the Black truffle salt. This little store that fell from heaven and landed in this cute little area of Portland was a gift from above. 

I can't wait to return in the future on my next trip to Portland from Los Angeles, but will continue to buy more on their website.

BUY THE TRUFFLE SALT!!! THE BEST!

I went to her yrs ago. she is crazy. she pushes her books, vegan agenda, a chiropractor ( her husband?) on you..she once gave me a physical.. her office called and said there was bad news and I needed to come in ..an emergency..but would not tell me over the phone..so I suffered thru a night of worry.. went in to see her the next day..she breezed in and I said "ok what is the bad news/emergency ?''  

she said " oh you need a B 12 shot and your thyroid is low" 

she just wanted to bilk my insurance .. which she complained about every visit..

I guess she is still around..yep, they are out there..practicing  ( in her case practicing  does not make perfect)

she might make a good veterinarian !

I contracted with Jasper last month for a re-roof of one of our rental properties.  I had seen some signs in the neighborhood and their local headquarters are in the same building as my employer.   Their employees seemed well dressed and they possess a polished appearance.  I worked with Rafael, an account manager, and he helped me with all of the paperwork and made it easy.  The work was scheduled and they were in and out in one day.  The roof looks terrific with the architectural shingles and the county inspector said they did a great job.  What more can you ask for?   I do recommend Jasper.

My fiance and I had a Groupon for a couples massage here and they were very easy to work with and schedule the massage.  The overall massages were great...I'd say 8.5/10.  I wish they would have asked about pressure because afterward both my fiance and I thought that at times we wished they dug in there a bit more.  We didn't ask for more pressure, however, so it is also on us, but typically they ask about the pressure when they start.  

If you want a great massage for a good price, this is a fantastic spot!  However, if you are looking for a very spa-like atmosphere, that just isn't there specialty.  It is good to know what to expect going in so you won't be disappointed.

This is the 3rd Will's Leather location that I've visited, and I have purchased a majority of my leather goods through Will's, so I do possess a basic knowledge of the standards in service when you walk into Will's Leather. I mean, not trying to be difficult here but it's hard for me to let these standards go because genuine, attentive customer service is why I love Will's so much, and why I have continued to come back. The first time I visited Will's Leather was at the Downtown Portland location on Burnside which have since closed. I have also frequented the Will's Leather back home in San Francisco - both experiences have been extremely pleasant and I've purchased items from both locations.

The experience I had at this location is completely different. I walked in on a Saturday afternoon and was not greeted by any staff, I could smell the espresso machine but was not offered any coffee, which you know honestly is fine. I don't expect to be catered to hands and feet but even with the one free espresso or water coupon with the Yelp Check-In I felt uncomfortable asking for it because all of the staff were congregated in a group around the check out counter having loud personal conversations. They didn't even cease their conversation one minute to help us, and there was about 4-6 other customers shopping in the store in addition of my boyfriend and I. To be honest one of the wonderful things I've encountered about Will's leather's sales staff is their knowledge. They are informative without being abrasive but in my experience at this location - both traits were missing which is both good and bad in my opinion.

To be fair these two stars are for the one sales rep that did approach my boyfriend when she saw him lingering around the belts and informed him that the belt he was holding ran small and that he should size up. But that was the real extent of any conversation. But good information for a customer who wants to drop 

Also I felt like this location didn't have as many choices as the other Will's I've been through. Their items seems sparse. I'm not sure if this is because they get heavy traffic through this location or they are just not replenishing their inventory regularly. We recently bought a bag at the Will's Leather location in SF, the sales rep there grabbed every bag in storage to help us choose our favorite, since Will's hand crafted leather is one of a kind. Here it was hard for me to find a different color in the item I wanted.

This is not a complaint since I love Will's Leather and will continue to spend my money there, but definitely feedback towards the customer service provided at this location. I mean, Will's Leather is from Oregon! Shouldn't that in itself up the stakes just a little?

It is definitely not comparable to Sur la Table, Kitchen Kaboodle, Crate and Barrel but if you have the urge to do something well and fancy with something that is basic, this is the place for you. 

What they have are mostly generics but decent selection of kitchen utensils, gadgets and what not. I did not find anything of specialty or unique. 

If you are a budding restaurateur, this is a place where you may want to start looking. They have brand new and used appliances that you will need in building your empire. 


I got overwhelmed by the pans and molds they have. So, those big muffin tins and tart molds can be found here. Those miniature mold for loaves of bread are present as well. Mini ramekins? They have it. 

Black and white aprons, table cloth, napkins, chopsticks, signage, menu folders, crumb brushes, they all have it. I am sure they can help you with other stuff but I've seen what is on display and it is pretty basic. They have personnel everywhere but it's hard to spot them as they are not in uniform nor wear name tags.

Great experience.  Extremely happy with end result.  
I shopped hard in a 250 mile circle of Portland for the right trailer. Out of all the contacts and dealers Chuck From Apache on 82nd was the most responsive, kind and helpful.    He patiently took us through the process of selecting what we wanted and provided competitive pricing on the final trailer as well as the accessory's I need for the tow vehicle.  

Kudos to Apache for helping out us first time RVers and massive thanks to Chuck for a positive sales journey.  Definitely worth including him in the conversation if you are shopping!!!

I highly recommend investing in a City Pass if you want to do anything touristy in Boston! We purchased one at the MoS and we have been having fun all week.

The MoS itself is pretty awesome. They have exhibits on anything you can think of, and they have a really awesome electricity show where get to watch someone create lightning inside! We were a little bummed because quite a few of the exhibit activities needed some service, but overall we had a great time. I highly recommend going to the planetarium! It is worth the extra $$!

We did, however, pick one of the worst days to go... we went on a Monday and were inundated with strollers and school field trips.

Communication between admins and the instructor is really bad. Waited for an hour for the second day of class and no one showed up. Had to call and find out what was happening, they ended up cancelling the class. I thought it just happened to us but apparently someone went through something similar in which they cancelled the class and didn't notify her. a waste of time!!! 

the program is good and the stuff he teaches are relevant but the organizing problems make it not worth it

For the past 3 months I've been in constant pain and not able to walk bc of plantar fasciitis. No one was able to help me until I found Dr. Lukoff. He has the latest technology and a proven treatment plan to help people with Plantar fasciitis. I've been doing the laser treatment for 3 treatments out of 10 and am 80% better. Picking up my custom orthodontics today and look forward to being able to feeling 100% very soon. The staff is so accommodating and nice so makes for a great experience every appointment.

I've been a continuous customer of Sloan Security since 1981 for multiple systems. They are a great value but you do have to take some personal responsibility yourself to make sure that everything is working properly. I have done two major refreshes of my home system with them over the years and both went smoothly. I have a big system that has a couple of unusual pieces and they have always managed to satisfy my requests. They typically do find some parts that are no longer working properly and that need replacement, which can raise the expected cost, but they do publish what each item will cost. I am familiar with the security systems of a few of my friends and am confident that they have paid 50% more than I have, both for installation and for monitoring, yet their experiences overall have been about the same as mine. Just like a car, security systems do need to be properly maintained.

Have been going to Cycle Loft for many years.  Always appreciate their professional service and knowledge.  Today they helped me with a drop in service to replace my chain.  In the process, they let me know my cassette was near replacement -- which I knew but forgot to ask about -- and asked it I wanted to go ahead and replace it now.  No pressure, just a suggestion.  This all while waiting outside in a well organized Covid setting to help with service.

Staff is rude and not very accommodating. If you are not 10 minutes early they consider you late. Also DO NOT forget or lose the paperwork your doctor gives you. Even though you spend 20 minutes relaying all the information on the form when you schedule the appointment they still "need it for confirmation, like a pharmacy needs a prescription." Without that form they then need verbal confirmation from your doctor and as we all know actually getting your doctor on the phone is next to impossible. So they will end up rescheduling you.

Review Update 5/16/18: The owner of the company reached out to apologize for the experience I had last week. I have written a response and decided to give the owner an opportunity to try and help me. I'm still befuddled as to how someone with 4 years in the mortgage business and an MBA degree is unable to be helped in a job search. I will update my review of this company once another response is received.

The recruiter I spoke with Chris Wallingford sucks. I made a call a week ago and sent my resume and he never called or emailed me back. When I did speak with him I got to "google" job postings, and go directly to job boards. He apparently does recruit in the financial industry, yet told me that my mortgage experience didn't align with finance? WTF... Guess what? The mortgage industry is all about finance genious and your follow up game is lousy. Why don't you try following up and doing your actual job called help people find f***ing jobs. This place blows. don't bother.

My family drove to Orlando to visit Disney World and we treated my mother in law to a free flight home to avoid the long drive back to Nashville. We hadn't thought much about how to get her to the Orlando  airport, so we are so glad we called Taxido. Denis was very professional, prompt and took great care of my MIL, getting her to the airport safely and on time. Online reservation and payment was very convenient too. We are very satisfied and would recommend to anyone.

Today I had my first experience packing food at Open Hand! It was cool - the whole method and rhythm of the process of sealing, labeling, stacking the meals . . . there's something nicely therapeutic about the routine, plus you know you're contributing to a great cause.

Over 20,000,000 meals have been delivered by Open Hand to people in our city who are chronically and terminally ill. I'm volunteering there this year as my placement with the Junior League of Atlanta (every member volunteers at least 50 hours a year in a community or in-League placement). We go one Saturday a month as a group and can pick up extra shifts as we like; my good friend and I are going to add a few meal-delivery routes to our hours in the next couple of months.

Mark, Chelsea and all the staff are very nice and work so hard. It's fun to meet the other volunteers, like the former chef who comes every other week and whoever else happens to be standing next to you working for the same end. And, the food is really good and healthy; some of it is made in house and other meals/ingredients are donated by Good Measure Meals, a meal-delivery company. Meals are well-labeled with ingredients and dietary specifications and all are noted with the date they should be consumed as well as whether they are part of the 1200 or 1800 calorie/day plan. Good stuff.

A nice Saturday morning, well-spent. And check out the site for the restaurants participating in the upcoming Dining Out For Life event in April- all kinds of great spots contribute up to 100% of their proceeds of everything sold that day!!

AMAZING service, great activity, good prices and killer deals.

I came here as a group of 10 for my friend's birthday and I had such a great time. We made our reservation for 4pm and even though we were seated around 4:45pm, it was no big deal because the guy was super accommodating. He told us we can look around to get ideas, pick our ceramic (mugs, plates, statues, bowls, etc) and gave us the run down on how the paint will look like once it was done. It was my first time at a clay room, but he made it so easy to understand everything! In our birthday package, each person paid $20 and we got to pick a $12 piece of ceramic, had access to all the different paints, got three pies of pizza of our choice and two cartons of lemonade! I MEAN WHAT A STEAL! Not only that, but because we had to wait, he let us stay and design for as long as we needed. 

It's also BYOB so in celebration, we had wine, cider, gummies, chocolates in addition to our pizza and lemonade. This is the perfect place to come for people of any age! You do have to come back to pick up your arts because it takes a few days for it to be complete, but other than that, it was a great experience!

We tried the Curry Chicken, Irish and Classic with Cheese Pies.  Sausage Roll and the Seafood Chowder.  The Curry Chicken had great flavor and was very good.  Irish Bowl and Classic with Cheese were nothing special.  The crust was pretty good but extremely spectacular.  

The Sausage roll was excellent, Good flavor and moist sausage.  The flaky crust was crispy and tasted light.    

The best item was the Seafood Chowder.  Very fresh and not too creamy.  It was a little spicy too.  Yummy!
