I came to Boston Watch & Clock Repair after reading so many glowing yelp reviews and was not disappointed!

I had let a little pile of dead battery watches build up until I had only one working watch left...it was time to take care of things. I brought four watches to them last week-- each needed a new battery, one needed a link removed, and one Skagen watch had had a piece come loose in the watch face and needed some extra love.

They told me to come back in an hour. The tab was...$40! Everything was done perfectly; despite some struggles with communication they clearly understand watches.

If you love a fabulous well-prepared steak do not eat at this place. My less than 1 inch thick ribeye was less than then fabulous. They added a 20% tip with only five people at our table. Who does this?I have seen this at a table of 8 but, a Table of 5? This place does not come anywhere close to a fabulous Steakhouse with great service great atmosphere and fabulous food. Wait, did I mention the parking. You will not believe this but the parking is nonexistent. If you want to crawl out your window to go eat dinner then you can park in this parking lot.

Here I am expecting to make an informed decision about a mail box service and the manipulation put on me was overkill. First there happens to be only 1 mailbox left (potential scarcity ploy), then I'm told it's 1 year minimum mail box service for $200 but for me they would do only 3 months for $75 (some tactic I'm sure to make it seem like I'm being cut a deal) then I'm told USPS doesn't take FedEx, DHL, or UPS to PO Boxes. I went to USPS and I'm actually told differently that all you do is sign up for FREE street addressing and USPS delivers all mail perfectly fine. USPS quoted me $20 for 3 months. I get you charge more for convenience but I don't appreciate someone not being straightforward with me. I had dealt with the younger guy who didn't seem like the owner so maybe it was just him.

I think it's great that Austin allows this kind of artistic outlet for it's residents. You could go once or twice a week and something will have always changed. The messages are all very unique. You may not understand some of them, and there will be an inappropriate one here and there, but it's art and you can't expect every person's taste to be the same as your own. I think they should add stairs with railing for better safety and get rid of any wires or nails that stick up in some places. You just have to be careful where you walk.

This is such a cute, hipster cafe! I enjoy the atmosphere a lot and the menu is so creative. The last time I came I got the Purple Pearl (Taro Latte) and it was really good but I forgot to take a picture. Today I ordered a Matcha Latte with almond milk, which was $5.68. A little pricey, but I understand because this area can be pretty hipster. My only complaint would be the wait time, there was only one employee working on a Saturday afternoon. I waited a while to order anything and waited even longer for my drink. Last time I came (around the same time/day) I got my order really quickly. It wasn't a huge problem though since I didn't gave anywhere to go, but I think if I was slightly pressed for time because the wait time is inconsistent.

Sometimes people don't go out of their way to make a review but i had such a good experience with this company that I just had to take a moment to post to say that John really took good care us with our used car purchase. With the report that we got from Auto p.i. inspectors we were able to make an informed decision on the purchase of our used vehicle which helped us negotiate the price. After we purchased the vehicle we found a bad bushing and loose bolt on the  subframe. We called John back told him what we found he sent his mechanic out to verify it, once he had it verified he had us bring the vehicle in to have repaired since it was stuff missed on their checklist. I will definitely be recommending this company to my friends and family because he backs up his work.

I have a lot of history with Lee's, which is appropriate since they've been around since 1869.  This is still a family operated business with the sixth generation at the helm and their kids still growing up on the farm and learning the ropes.  

In the summer this place is all about berries.  They operate U-pick for strawberries (season just ended), blueberries and marionberries.  If you don't want to do the work, they sell fresh picked berries in their store and also make fresh berry pies daily and sell jams and preserves.  They have a nice selection of pepper jellies, one of my favorites.

Most farms really hit their stride in the fall and Lee's has a lot of special activities.  They have a pumpkin patch, hay maze, fresh made cider, hay rides and pony rides.  My kids have gone here almost every year on school field trips and always have a great time.  In fact, one of their highlights is the barnyard petting zoo.  My youngest still giggles remembering the little puppies who jumped all over him and nibbled on his shirt.  He loves to show off the hole every time he wears that shirt.

They do a huge business at Christmas and have both fresh cut and u-cut trees for sale.  They have a shaker (yay!) to get rid of all those pesky dead needles and even sell their own special tree stand.  The store is filled with seasonal decorations as well.

A couple reasons why this isn't a five star rave is that I do find their prices on the expensive side.  Also, for all the history we have, I still don't have a great deal of affection for the place.  My warm fuzzies go to Fir Point Farms in Aurora.

Deceased Pet Care promises "same day" and "24 hour" service on their website in addition to "full-time funeral directors". There is no mention of 'regular business hours' on their website. My Chihuahua, Tinkerbell, passed away on Friday (1/2/2015) at the UGA emergency vet. I agreed to have Deceased Pet Care take care of the cremation process based on the high recommendation from the veterinarian. The doctor said I would receive a phone call from the company "soon". I waited all day Saturday and Sunday on that phone call. When 9:00 pm Sunday arrived, I was distraught and disgusted by the company's apparent lack of respect for my loss. I called the number provided on the website and was received by an answering service. This was the same answering service that a message was left with on Friday night. The answering service was unable to provide specific information concerning Tinkerbell. I requested the advertised "full-time funeral director" call me back so I could figure out where my pet was. I received a call back from Jullian. Jullian first told me she didn't know where Tinkerbell was, in addition to not having any record of her existence. Later in the conversation, Jullian said Tinkerbell was "probably at UGA still". At the end of our conversation, Jullian admitted Tinkerbell was at UGA. When asked how she suddenly acquired this new knowledge, Jullian said they didn't pick up pets on the weekends. I mentioned the website and the statements about 24-hour service. Jullian became very rude, argumentative, and arrogant. She said their company has "regular business hours". She told me that I was being outrageous for asking for anything more from the company. I told her I only wanted a phone call. She said I would receive one next week. She also claimed that I "inconveniencing" her when I made her pull her car over to the roadside to speak to me. We ended the conversation with me requesting a phone call from Jullian's boss. I waited on the second phone call for about an hour. In the interim, I contacted UGA and requested a different company pick Tinkerbell up. I never received a call from Deceased Pet Care, so I called Jullian back. She was again argumentative and cold. I cancelled her services. The level of service I received from Deceased Pet Care was deplorable. I expected a phone call at least by Saturday and never heard anything. I expected a kind, respectful, caring funeral director, but spoke to Jullian instead. I can't believe this company is recommended by Dale Cardwell. Apparently Dale Cardwell hasn't gone through the heart wrenching experience I went through after losing my loved one. I truly believe this company is misleading its customers with false advertising and terrible service.

Don't ever buy a car from them! EVERY step of the process was messed up!! It took 3 extra days to get my car, needed immediate service on the vehicle, the service department rescheduling me multiple times and then didn't  have a loaner car when previously promised, and now I've called 6 times in the last 4 weeks and can not get a response from the manager of the financing department (Mike Hannah) after he swore that he would personally help in the situation. It's impossible to get a hold of anyone via phone if you have issues after. 

Totally infuriating, and I'll never do any business with them ever again.

We cannot begin to explain how delighted we are with Kevin and Pamela at Upholstery on Broadway.  Right from the very first contact, they listened and understood what we were looking for.  Pamela found us the perfect fabric!  Then we (masked and socially distanced) met Kevin, who worked out how to utilize the bright patterns in the most attractive and economical way.  It was so much fun to bring back an old family chair (70+ years old) that is filled with memories for me.  Kevin did an amazing job!  Thank you both for the joy you have given us during this challenging time.  BRAVO!  We WILL be back.

Just had lunch at James Hook. My husband and I tried some of everything and here's the analysis...

Lobster Roll - Good value at $12. Lots of meat, little mayo, standard, grocery store roll. 

Boiled Lobster - Terrible. So  salty, it tasted like they never change the water. Borderline inedible, even for salt lovers like ourselves. 

Baked Clam - All breading, no meat. 

Baked Scallop - Marginally better than the baked clam. 

Overall, not a bad value but stick to the lobster roll. My husband disagrees and rates this a "Don't eat here"

These guys are legit. Rebuild my Johnson 90 and it has never run better. The final bill was close to $1000 less that the original quote because Chris was able to clean up and reuse some on the parts. After he broke down the engine he asked me to drop by the shop and showed me the damage and what parts he felt were still good, giving me the option to go with all new or with some reused parts. In addition the guys are all friendly as opposed to some motorheads who have no social skills.

We had our daughter in the Beth Israel labor/delivery wing earlier this week. We were so happy with our care; if and when we have a second child, we would do it again at Beth Israel in a heartbeat.

We stayed in the post-birth wing on the sixth floor for two days. A steady stream of services came to our door over those two days: create the birth certificate for our daughter; check in on mom; test our daughter's hearing; give her the hepatitis-B vaccine; a first visit from a pediatrician within our practice; give mom Rice Krispy treats if she wants them; etc.

The delivery itself was a little complicated, and our daughter had to spend her first hour of life in the NICU. This could have been terrifying, but the doctors and nurses did everything they could to calm us down, including making sure to update us when anything changed. I'm tearing up just remembering it.

It probably goes without saying that the BI is one of the best hospitals on earth. Had anything gone catastrophically wrong, I'm sure we would have been in the best possible hands.

Went out with a group of friends, very diverse crowd and was turned down entry at the bar.  This was cited as because two in the party of 9 had on "ripped jeans". When we pointed out a multitude of people that had already been admitted to the bar had on ripped jeans it became apparent this was more about the color of the skin the people wearing the jeans had on rather than the jeans themselves. In reading the reviews on this business, discrimination isn't a new theme for this place. Please consider spending your money elsewhere rather than an establishment that seems to encourage this behavior.

This observatory sits just one floor below Top of the Hub. It costs $15 to come up here, but you get a 360 view of the city. You can actually get the same view from Top of the Hub, so I wouldn't recommend doing both if you want to save money.

It is a nice view from here, but Boston isn't all that interesting. So whether it was worth the money, I don't know. It is completely indoors, which I thought was nice. East Coast weather is pretty harsh. They have mini museums where they talk about the city's history, but I didn't really have any time to pay attention.

This was my first time EVER playing bingo, and I took a group of girls with me.  It was a ton of fun and we all had a great time despite not winning anything.  I read all the reviews on Yelp but was still confused on how everything went down, so let me clarify a few things.

You obviously have to be 18 and up, and you go and buy cards to play on.  You have the option of how many cards you want to play, we all bought 18 for $7, which was a pretty good amount.  If it is your first time at B-12 you get a free dabber!  This is a great deal, since I was worried about buying one before I went and no one seems to sell them.

When the game is going, the hall is like a funeral!  You have to be really quiet when you play so you can hear all the numbers.  You can even buy more cards for the next round, and they have raffles midway through.  Prizes were $300, $400, $500, and $700 a round.  The staff is extremely helpful and will assist you if you have any questions at all!

Definitely a great choice if you're looking for something to do.  Good luck!

I had a root canal performed here many years ago. Both Dr. Santamaria and Dr. Warshauer participated in the procedure. It wasn't done very expeditiously, but I assumed the dentists had done an acceptable job. However, the crown never felt right. I have no other crowns, so I just assumed it was supposed to feel odd. Bits of food constantly got impacted there, and it was very uncomfortable. Several years later, a good dentist pointed out that the crown was extremely ill-fitting. There was, in dental jargon, a very obvious short distal margin, and the gingival tissue in the area was very inflamed. I called Dr. Warshauer & Santamaria's office to see what could be done (by then, I had moved to a different state), and the receptionist was exceptionally rude. She took a very accusatory tone and suggested that I was lying or attempting to somehow exploit my complaint. I was so upset by the encounter that I never called back. 

I ended up having the root canal redone by a skilled endodontist, and he discovered that on top of the ill-fitting crown, Dr. Santamaria and Dr. Warshauer had completely missed an entire canal. My general dentist fitted me with a new crown, and it feels drastically better than the old one. 

Long story short: Don't go here. And never get a root canal done by a general dentist. Always go to an endodontist, a specialist in root canals.

This is a mixed review. I've used Herrell Plumbing twice within a two month period for separate issues at the same address. To spare you the details I'll sum it up by saying that the techs they send out are great, they do their job quick, and diagnose issues rather quickly. The cost of this service is always something people are going to hate, but saving me a day of wasting time and playing with dirty sewage/pipe snakes is worth the $200 to resolve a clogged main drain. You can never expect a plumber to fix a hole which they will more than likely make to find a leak ( expect to call a handyman or repair the drywall yourself ).

But the weak leg I've found to be with dealing with Herrell Plumbing is the ladies in the offices. Anything aside from scheduling a technician is beyond their capabilities. During my first call ( after finding them here on yelp ) and not wanting to deal with Emerald Plumbing from seeing them work on several projects, I called them up and scheduled a visit due to a clogged drainage system. Specifying that I would give a Credit Card number to confirm the appointment but that I would be in the same day to drop off payment in the form of a check to have it drafted directly from my bank account for these types of issues. The technician showed up and handled the clog within 30 minutes of arriving and was cool enough to call me giving me a heads up about what had gone on.

I showed up to their offices as promised and dropped off a check to a woman working the office who didn't seem to know what property I was talking about. 3 weeks later and after noticing multiple attempts to collect the fee from my credit card I called up their offices but was told I needed to make payment. At this point I'm worried because ( who did I give my check to ? ). Turns out when I show up to their offices and speak to whoever I was able to find in one of the cubicles she's told that "oh here it is in the file, we JUST received it".

Happy with their service at the house and having now a leakage issue with some plumbing I called them back up, after dealing with the technician they sent this time I was happy the issue was being diagnosed effectively. Unfortunately during a few call backs from myself requesting more info regarding a repair estimate, current charges, and more information regarding the issue I was told to hold and wait for a call " I'll call you back shortly". Well a day and a half later no call, so I called up the tech directly and dealt with him like I should have from the beginning.

My advice, if you have specific payment requirements make sure to be clear and specific about your intent with the office staff. If you need to request more information aside from your appointment time/date, deal with the technicians directly, the office has no clue and will more than likely not contact you back. Maybe my $200-800 jobs are small potatoes for these people, so I won't be bothering them anymore with business from me. I'll risk it and call up the next company.

5 Stars for the tech's
2 Stars for the office staff.

How cool was this event! I'm a total big kid at heart and it was so nice to relax and enjoy some quality magic tricks and a little comedy!

Thanks to Andi and Yelp Elite I got a chance to experience Magic Mansion's opening night acts! Suhhhh-weeeet!

Magic Mansion is held at the Historic Dr. Phillips house in Downtown Orlando. This beautiful historic site is still used regularly as a hotel. Sites like this AMAZE me! I've lived in Orlando for 3 years and I frequent the Lake Cherokee area and I never knew about this beautiful piece of historic Orlando hiding next to Lake Lucerne. I was in nerdy awe!! Although we were only given access to the first floor and back courtyard it appears the home has 3 levels and after seeing how spacious and decorative the bottom level was I can only imagine what the other floors have to offer - I wish I could've gone on a little tour!! He he!

Magic Mansion is hosted by See Magic Live! Orlando's top of the line magical performers! I first met some of these awesome guys at Yelp Elite's Magical Dining Month Kick-Off Party. Not only were they incredibly personable but they are skilled at their craft. My personal favorite - card tricks! And my favorite SML magician is Sebastian - he's a total pro and been in the business for 7 years to date. I was so happy to see Sebastian moving about the house wowing the masses. 

When visiting Magic Mansion you can wander about the house into various rooms and watch your favorite SML magicians in action at small tables. Or head out to the court yard where they hold nightly magic shows for larger groups and also where they have light bites for purchase. Inside upon entry you are able to purchase a beverage of your choice. 

I really enjoyed myself and this opportunity to experience a little magic and a little history in one spot. Every magician had something new to show his audience and made it their own. If you haven't been to Magic Mansion you need to go! Time is limited so get there NOW!

I don't shop T&SS because I'm loyal, I'm loyal because I buy something at T&SS I can't get anywhere else; expertise, personalization and patience.  Ultimately, T&SS helps me enjoy my sport more. 
I am a second generation customer, and soon there will be a third. I've tried to buy tennis and squash racquets and shoes elsewhere, but never had the confidence I have after talking with Johnathan.  Which has meant I've played the racquets far longer than I should have because they were a perfect fit from the beginning. I'm finally in need of new equipment and, after spending hours reading on-line reviews and talking with sales people without satisfaction I'm going back.

Bill Gammon is a helpful guy all-around. He takes the time on the phone to really identify your unique issue and then provide an effective solution. For me, it was referring me to another attorney. That attorney was willing to work with me and made the process of my case easier, while other law offices erect a wall before you can even get through to an actual attorney. It seems everyone in Mr. Gammon's circle of influence has a high degree of integrity and professionalism. I would definitely use him again for my legal needs in Austin.

After being initially turned off on apartment location services due to a bad experience with one agent, a friend referred me to Lisa at apartment specialists. From the beginning she listened to my priorities and concerns and helped me find the perfect place. Even though I was indecisive and had what probably seemed like crazy reasons for not wanting to be in certain properties, Lisa never batted an eye and took me out to different properties on two different days. It's important to find someone you trust, and when you do, it makes apartment searches much less stressful.

Great service!  I often do my own repairs but dont always have time.  I appreciated that these guys were kind, honest and got the job done well.  Turnaround was quick.

Given experiences with many florida dealers and repair places trying to do repairs and service thats not needed, I will definitely use these guys again, I would highly recommend them and Id trust my wife taking her car there.

Check these guys out!

You all are awesome - happy to spread the word.

Adam is a total professional through and through.  He arrived on time (actually, he beat me to my house by 2 minutes!) and ready to work.  Prior to installation and during, he provided knowledgable, experienced advice about how to better ensure the longevity of some of our outdoor locks, things to consider for installing an outdoor keypad, and more.  He's a total delight and was in and out in less than 30 minutes to replace several locks in our house. His pricing is totally fair and transparent.  All in all, Adam is a great guy and you should totally hire him to be your key guy!

I cannot express how surprised/relieved I was by how easy and simple this was. Like many who have reviewed, I noticed my passport was within 6 months of expiring and I have a flight in 2 days. I looked up various courier agencies who advertise 24-hour service and charge upwards of $500 when government fees are included. I instead drove to this agency from Nashville, with no appointment, and had zero problems. I got there at 9am and within 10 minutes was done with the process. I'm told my passport will be ready by 2pm, and it cost $170. couldn't be happier!

Hands down, the freshest and best tasting Kolaches I've had in TX! We tried the brisket one, the sausage and cheese, the pepperoni, which my son devoured. Also, the chocolate, the poppy and the apple pie one. They are all so yummy, but the brisket from the savory and the chocolate from the sweet kind are my favorite. 
Cool decor, great choices for coffee drinks, beers or bottled sodas. There's cornhole out in the backyard for friends & family fun.
Wish we lived closer, but we are willing to drive 30 min. to get this delicious Kolache goodness from Batch! Last but not least, thank you guys for your great customer service! The girl who took our order was so friendly and kind.

I was so excited about this experience and it disappointed on every single level. 
I paid $130 (excluding tip!) for me and my husband to go to 4 distilleries, all of which were well within walking distance of where we met Andrew - the guy who was going to be our "guide". The whole thing took about 2.5 hours. 

The Distillery Row Passport that is part of this experience costs $20 per person and if you buy it for yourself, it includes all of the tastings that are part of this pedicab tour (and each distillery tries to upsell you on "better" tastings). So, I paid $130 for something that costs $40 which means that the remaining $90 (excluding the tip I was "forced" to give) was the cost of the pedicab taking us around these very walkable distilleries in the same neighborhood. Had I ordered ubers from one distillery to another, the whole transportation cost would have been under $20. 

The worst part about this overpriced experience however was Andrew. He was completely disengaged and did not volunteer any information on any of the distilleries that we visited. I asked a number of questions trying to learn more about each place and the process they use to make their alcohol but my efforts didn't go anywhere. However, the first thing he said upon meeting us was that he works for tips and tips are very much appreciated. 

I live in Portland and wanted to do a trial run of this service for when a number of out of town friends visit PDX this summer. I was very disappointed and felt cheated by this service.

I have never been to a sushi making class, but after the intro class at sea to you sushi I'd recommend it to anyone looking for a fun and delicious evening. The instructor was great! I felt a bit nervous at first but he was really funny and also made you feel really comfortable.  The sushi was also really good, fresh ingredients, and although I only had the basic ingredients, you can order additional fishes and other things.  

Also what you make but don't eat you get to take home! So it was perfect for my wife and I! I got to eat plenty and she gets to take hers home and eat it at her leisure.

Overall, we had a blast and especially recommend the class to couples, families, and friends who like sushi.

I have been working with Dimov Partners for a few years now and the most surprising thing to me is; while most other companies I deal with have consistently lost the commitment to customer service and personal attention, Dimov Partners commitment to my satisfaction grows each year.  They are always willing to answer my questions and offer options that best fit my circumstances or needs as the time. Especially this year,  with all the changes to the tax laws, they made sure to take extra time to explain everything in detail and afforded me the ability to understand completely. It is comforting to know that I have people of this quality in my corner and watching my back.

We just came in for my daughter's second birthday party, my husband and I came in with both arms absolutely full with party supplies and our sleeping daughter 30 minutes early to be greeted extremely rudely by a brown haired girl with a heart shaped necklace. We were informed without a drop of sympathy that our table was not ready yet and we were not permitted to check in until 5 minutes prior to the party time. Before we were able to open our mouths she told us "it's on our website" and turned around to help someone else. 
If we hadn't paid a deposit we would have walked right out and rescheduled the party at home. Absolutely disgusting customer service, we will never book with crash crawleys again!

What can I say but what an amazing place. The staff is amazing and really loves and cares for their clients. Our little boy has flourished because of the dedication of Ashley, the staff and Lanny from Beloved Montessori school in West Linn. I know many people that Ashley and her team have helped. If your child or loved one is having difficulty, it is isn't a problem, it just might be they learn differently and all they need is the tools to do great things. Ashley and her team, gives them the tools, guidance, love and support to do great things. Thank you guys so much

My wife and I just took a month long trip to Japan and we needed someone to help us take care of our cat while we were away.  We were really worried about it until I found Lisa and Loving Pet Care.  I could tell from the moment I met her that she genuinely loves animals and she was the perfect person to be here while we were away.  

Our cat is particularly skittish around people that he doesn't know, and she went above and beyond to make sure that he felt comfortable around her.  She even helped us by watering plants and picking up our mail while we were out of town.  

Pets are like family, and I would strongly recommend her to anyone that is looking for someone they can trust to take care of their animal friends while they are out of town!

Avoid Dr. Tiffany Clay!! I saw her for all of 5 minutes and she said she would prescribe me medicine "that probably won't work." When I questioned why she'd prescribe medicine that she didn't think would work she said that she's an "expert who looks at skin all day." Funny since my total time meeting with her was 5 minutes. Her medical assistant also tried to give medical advice prior to Dr. Clay coming in the room. This was extremely annoying since I wasn't paying $175 to get unsolicited medical advice from the medical assistant. Also the booking process is a bit annoying. The appointment reminders they send come in the form emails with highlights and words written in bold--"Final notice: Appointment tomorrow." Who sends an appointment reminder that looks so aggressive? Overall, I'd go to another doctor and not the "expert" token used for diversity photos.

I've had many massages both in Boston and throughout SE Asia when I used to travel. The massage at Cabral wellness with Stephanie was in my top three. I rebooked the next day for my next visit cause it was that good. The reception was friendly, there was an appropriate amount of pressure applied during the massage and the overall ambiance professional and relaxing. My only little qualm is while my muscles felt worked on during the massage, I felt tense again the next day. I'll be back again this week, so we'll see if that was just a one time thing. I still highly recommend them!

We had a blast at Playland. I'm not crazy about their skating floor. It's white vinyl or something along those lines that is more slippery than the wooden floors at the rink we usually skate at. Overall though, you can't go wrong taking a big bunch of kids to a rink. They burn off their energy, get their exercise, have a great time and then come home ready to eat and hit the sack. Playland was clean and the staff was great. Very friendly and helpful.

I wish I would have read the reviews of this place before telling my doctor to send me here for blood work. It smells like cigarettes when you walk in. The lady behind the counter was barking orders at the poor nurse and the patients. There was a little old lady ahead of me and the women behind the counter started asking her personal questions in from of everyone. Is there no room to take patients into? Then after I got my blood drawn, I stood up and blood came rushing down my arm. Not cool!! If you have a choice in going to a different lab, please do so. You've been warned....

My first trip to the Paak was aftah my eleventh birthday when my ma and dad took me to see the Sawx play Cal Ripken and the fahckin' Orioles.  As a young adult from New Hampsha I was moah than happy to see Wade Boggs, Dwight Evans and Greenwell kick some fahckin Oriole ayss.

I took Helen's free class at Athleta in Dedham and it was awesome! I usually don't wake up early on Sunday (ok, I never do) but I made my way to her HIIT class. It kicked my butt, but in the best way possible! Helen explained each exercise, gave us modifications, and also reassured us that it's okay to rest! She cheered us on through 3 rounds of a challenging circuit, which definitely motivated to keep pushing myself. I appreciated her enthusiasm so early in the morning -- it was clear how much she love her job and really wanted all of us in her class to succeed. I was definitely sore the next day (that soreness that tells you that you worked really hard!) which is a good sign! I will definitely take more of her classes!

I really do like this place and honestly have never had a bad experience here until a few weeks ago. 

I came here with a friend on Oct 17th. It was steady but I wouldn't say busy by any means. Our first round of drinks came within minutes. After talking and relaxing we decided to order the spinach and artichoke dip for something to snack on. It came, cold, and it took about no joke 25 minutes to arrive. The waitress, Mary, NEVER checked on us once asking how our food was. We did request veggies with our dip but those never came. Another server dropped our food off and when she did we asked her for another round of drinks. Fast forward another 20 minutes, we still have no drinks. I hate to complain in restaurants because you never know what's happening behind the scene but at least come by and check up on us. When Mary finally did, now a solid 40 mins since we first got our food...we had told her we ordered drinks with the other waitress. Mary's response was incredibly offensive: "well her english is really bad so she probably didn't know...." Um, thats rude.

Anyways, we finally got our veggies to eat with our cold dip. It would of been nice to you know, maybe receive a fresh and hot one, but that was never offered to us. We finally asked for the check and that took another 15 minutes to get and then another 10 minutes before she brought our cards back. 4 drinks and a spinach and artichoke dip over the course of 2 hours was not worth the $50 and aggravation. 

I never leave less than 20% ever, but this time I had to. Sorry.

I'll definitely be back as every place has it's off night.

Kevyn is great!  I'm going to plan on using him twice a year.   As I've gotten older, house maintenance is getting harder for me to do.  I noticed just after the last big rain, my gutter was looking like Niagara Falls.  I don't have any large trees nearby, but the gutters haven't done that ever so I knew they had to be filled with debris. Kevyn gave me a reasonable quote for both the gutters and cleaning all the windows in the house.   And he even pointed out some moss patches that were beginning to take hold and should be treated as well.  So I had him do all three tasks which he accomplished in a short amount of time but he didn't skimp on the attention to detail.  Kevyn is a Vancouver native, local family man and just a nice person.  He was prompt when he arrived, worked tirelessly till it was all completed and I feel I really got my monies worth.   He'll be back in the spring for another window washing!   I heartily recommend Diamond Window and Gutter Cleaning!!

Took the day off from work to come bike riding on a beautiful day! Totally worth it especially during a time where we have to exercise caution in our day to day activities due to the pandemic so this was just what the doctor ordered. 
I brought my own bike but apparently you can rent one here, and there's restrooms and even a play area for kids. Plentiful parking, and the trail itself is pretty cool. Not as scenic as other trails I've been to but still very nice. 

So, we all know Florida is flat, but ummm.. get ready for this trail. Claremont in itself is notoriously hilly and you'll feel it when you're bike riding, this will be a vigorous workout especially if you're not use to it! 
I read in other reviews that there's a route where you ride past a brewery but the way we went was strictly lakes, hills, neighborhoods etc.

Lakeridge winery is nearby and we ended up stopping by there afterwards; give yourself something to look forward to after all that exercise!

I was super confused as I was eating my noodles because my brain was having such a hard time decoding the flavors haha.

I ordered the Mine Frire with medium spicy.  When it came out the girl asked if I wanted the mint cilantro chutney on there, and I was confused, but I said sure.  The chutney turned out to be the best part about the dish.  So the Mine Frire is a stir fried yakisoba noodle dish, and I think it is probably the one dish from Chez Dodo that really embodies most of the influences of African, French, Indian, Chinese and Creole cuisines that you see it proudly labeled on the cart.  The Indian and Chinese influeces were pretty obvious from the chutney and the stir fried noodles.  It's the other 3 influences that will have your brain guessing what is what.  Eventually I gave up trying to figure out and just went with it.  It really is this mix mash of savory flavors for the noodles and chicken, then you add the refreshing chutney and somehow it all makes sense.  Overall, the noodles were good, but the chutney was what did it for me.  Also medium wasn't really that spicy so definitely go higher if you like spicy food.

$10 for a large plate of noodles with chicken.  A bit more expensive for lamb!

I was promised to pick up on Staurday, got there and it wasn't ready, and the gentlemen that does engravings had taken the day off. So, it appeared that my item wasn't going to be ready. However, the other gentleman working said he might be able to do it, due to his lack of confidence I told him not to worry about it. A few hours later I got a phone call saying it was ready. The inconfident gentleman decided to try it anyways. The engraving did turn out pretty good. However the customer service was lacking in several areas. That will be only experience with them, as I will not ever go back.

Came here for a concert. It was not a good experience. I couldn't see even though I had seats near the front. Lines were long and slow moving for everything. The food we had was sub-par.  Parking was in a field and was a long way from the venue.  There was a free shuttle though. Unisex bathroom was off putting. I don't want men in the bathroom with me! Most importantly, the lack of police at the venue was disturbing! Concert was sold out and I saw one police officer the entire night. Not a lot of staff members either. We actually left way early because it was that bad.

I have had chronic muscular pain all over my body for over 10 years now, and in that time I've seen far too many doctors. I often felt like they didn't believe me, or thought I was there to score drugs. 

No one took my condition seriously until Dr. Gregory. And no one has helped me as much as she has. She stays with me as long as she can. I'm grateful for that, she does care--don't let the tough exterior fool you.

Unfortunately, the staff can be sometimes forgetful. A couple of times, I've shown up at the pharmacy only to find out no prescription was sent. But the worst instance was when they forgot to send my blood to the lab, so then I had to redo the whole thing and get poked again. Yeah...

Still, I keep coming to Dr. Gregory. She's gained my trust and continues to care about my well-being. That's who I need as a doctor.

This was surprisingly fantastic! I ended up riding it three times I liked it so much!

This is a fast paced roller coaster ride with twists, drops, and sudden stops. They throw in some projections, some animatronics, special effects, and more! It has a little story and one where despite riding it three times am really not sure if it had a happy end, but one that made me giggle. 

They offer free lockers to stash your stuff, which is imperative to do so. The line is dark, but each time I went it was extremely fast moving so I didn't have a chance to look at any of the distractions they had. They had a video running in the beginning but I only caught a couple sentences before moving on. One thing that I had to giggle at was how seriously gloomy the ride attendants purposefully was. The last time we went the ride attendant said not a word and simply briskly pointed to where we were to go. Each time the ride started instead of their typical thumbs up for clearance they would give a thumbs down. I loved it because the story was about curses and mummies so their small actions kept the tone. 

It really was a fun ride and one I would recommend!

TL;DR: Spent the night in the ER, needed cab home. Called at 5, and got hung up on, on hold for long periods, handed from one dispatch to the next, they lost history of my first call, and strung me along with "He's 5 minutes away" for two and a half hours. I will never give them my business again. 

Absolutely the worst service I have ever received. Do not call them! 
I had an asthma attack and took an ambulance to the hospital, so when my medical emergency was taken care of and I was discharged at 5am, my husband and I needed to take a cab home.

He called from his phone at 5, and dispatch said somebody would be there in 15 minutes. Half an hour later, we get a call from the taxi driver saying our address doesn't exist. (The address of the providence emergency room in Milwaukee, does indeed exist as I was sitting in the brick and mortar waiting room) After trying to explain, he hung up and we didn't hear back and he wouldn't pick up. So we waited some more, and finally I called on my phone at 5:54. 

No answer, no hold, just a busy line. Tried back a minute later, was put on hold for 8 minutes, and the lady says a cabs on its way in 8 minutes. Also, has no record of the first taxi we ordered an hour ago. I wait half an hour and call back at 6:30, another long hold and  she says oh he's on his way, 15 minutes. I call at 7 and tell them I've been waiting for two hours now. They hang up on me. I call back, another long hold, and am told 5 more minutes. 7:18 I call again, am told he's 15 minutes away. Estimated fare would be $20ish. 

I requested they cancel the taxi that was never coming to me. Got on my uber app, got an uber in 3 minutes, I was home ten minutes later and it cost me $11. 

I'm very disappointed in this company's lack of regard for their costumers. I was treated very poorly by the dispatchers and straight up lied to multiple times. I don't know how they can continue to run a business like this. And I will never use this company again.

AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COSTS. We have had our son in Ecokids for several months now and we have had numerous problems with them. They are understaffed, overpriced, and have huge lack of communication issues. We have talked to Albert numerous times regarding our concerns and he says he will fix it but never follows through. Our son has had issues with his teach Ms Ashley since day one. I have to admit every time I have ever had any communication/interaction with her she has been very unprofessional, and down right rude. They fail to notify parents of injuries and incidents. At least once a week our son comes home and tells us to another kid has hit him, scratched him, or bitten him. Again, no incident reports are ever filled out and they do not notify us, we have to find out from our son. Again do your child and yourself a favor and avoid ECOKIDS.  I wish I would have never enrolled my child in the SAD excuse of a day care. THIS PLACE IS A NIGHTMARE.

I've been hearing about this for so long, and I was very pleased with how everything tasted! Walking in initially it was really quiet and a little intimidating because it was so empty. But it was also the end of the night so, I did not walk in until close to 8pm. 

The women at the counter were very friendly and knowledgable about the food. I order the potato and channa (chickpea) roti, with the roti dough on the side. The portions are huge and definitely shareable unless you want to keep a second meal for yourself!

For informational purposes only. I wish they had places like this when I was growing up. An awesome indoor bike park with ramps, jumps, bridges, banks and more. All obstacles are well built and maintained. Bikes and safety equipment are available to rent if your visiting from out of town or want to try a different size bmx bike with out shelling out $600 or more $$$.

They also have a great little arcade to enjoy or use while you rest up after a long run. Also inside is a great little pizza restaurant that also has beer and some liquor available for the adults while the kids enjoy the bike park. 

Once again what a great place. I hope you go and check it out.

Avoid this company if you can. When I first researched foundation repair I thought they were the best in the area but I think I was wrong. They had to come out and redo a repair and we didn't have the best experience the first time they came out either. 

The initial install- was two jacks and 5 carbon fiber strips. We moved all items away from the workspace and somehow they still managed to fling a concrete dust over everything. When they left we had a thick coat of concrete dust on all of our stuff to clean off. This was not very professional and a little annoying. 

The repair- I got a call at 12:54 that some of the work they did was with expired epoxy so they were wanting to come back out and redo it that afternoon. Yea, they gave me 1hr heads up that they were coming to repair some stuff. It's good that they let us know and we're proactive about fixing it, that's why I gave them more than 1 Star. However I had not planned on hearing the loud noises outside my place today. They are literally cutting out the strips they put in and stripping them off. It's even more annoying and a little inconvenient. The strips also don't cut out easily so they're grinding it down slowly and dust is getting inside. 

Service- it also seemed in conversations that the foreman didn't know what work they were doing. It seems like the workers knew though so we were ok with that. 

Price- they are expensive but I thought at the time, the price was worth it because you don't want to skimp on foundation repair. My opinion now is that these guys are not worth the fancy pricing, they have all the newest gear but not the most qualified ppl. I should have just hired someone else. 

Sales- sales is pushy to make a decision quickly but I understand they're just trying to do their job. I like time to think about $10k+ projects so I really had to hold my ground on giving me time, which he was eventually understanding of. 

Overall they're not terrible but I hope they're not the best in Portland because it was just be sad.

Took my car into car toys to get a full deluxe detail they said would you like us to remove the front seats and get under neath there for 45$ mind you I said sure go ahead might as well get it all done. So of course it took a while to get done picked it up at dark looked at it once I got home with a light still have change underneath the seat rail which makes me assume they never removed the seats thanks for charging me 45$ for nothing!

As good as they come. GREAT M.D., great staff. He has been my doctor for five years. Very easy to talk to and you can tell very much cares about you as a patient. Recognized by Texas Monthly as "One of the Top Doctors in Texas."

For the person rating he and his office one-star because you couldn't get an appointment, there's a reason. He's not taking new patients and there is a six-month wait to be one. I'll let you guess the reason why and it's not because he slow or understaffed.

Fantastic doctor and person.

I called because I needed my garbage disposal replaced. I had another appointment with a company, however they were very unprofessional and arrived later than scheduled, and thought I was okay with them just 'showing up anytime' and not calling.
After declining their services, I quickly looked online to find a licensed, dependable plumber who could replace my older garbage disposal with a new one. 
Robert and Alston arrived at my home on time and as scheduled. They took their shoes off prior to entering my home....a nice plus since we don't wear shoes in the house.
They assessed the situation quickly, asked me some troubleshooting questions and quickly got to work. The job itself was relatively quick, and well under the estimated proposed time. Thankfully I had no additional issues such as water leakage or damage from my disposal or pipes underneath the sink. 
These gentleman were professional, answering service calls outside of the home, which was very pleasant to see them do that. They tagged team at every interval and double checked the work when it was completed. 
Prior to closing the sale, I was asked if I had questions-which I had one that was answered. They cleaned up and took the old disposal with them.....so no cleanup for me!

Would I call them again? Absolutely!
Would I refer them out to my friends and family? I've already done it!

Can I drop an F-bomb here?

This is ****ing awesome!

Pick your princess and she arrives like a queen! You see her coming to the door in full dress, happy as can be, or you can hide her and surprise the s*** out of your little one.

Not only does she come decked out exactly like the princess your princess wants to see but she OWNS the space. Like really OWNS it!

That's so great! We hired Belle - Beast's counterpart in Beauty and the Beast. My little girl got herself all decked out in her Belle dress and shiny shoes.

When Princess Belle arrived toddler/pre-K chaos ensued. Little kids (girls and boys) hugged her, asked a million questions, and were awestruck to see the actual, real, Princess Belle.

Did you marry Beast? I love your dress. Can I touch your dress? Can I sit on your lap? Can I hug you too?

Awesome. Just awesome. So well done.

The kids called her "your majesty" - she was that good. 

And then it only got better. I was expecting some pretty good meet-and-greet and full-on engagement with the Princess. 

We got that and more. Then there was - as the website says - magic, singing, dancing, etc. It was probably rehearsed but it was so well done - and flexible - that our Princess was ready for kids. (It's not easy to be ready for 8 crazy 4 year olds!)

The Princess knew how to engage the kids. Had all her tricks ready to go. She was Princess Belle, exactly. Better than expected.

Even as some kids held her dress trail, others trying to get up in there, and all of the chaos that little kids are famous for, she held her character and commanded respect.

Well done.

Price? Fair. Although the pics from this will are the best of my life. And I'm old.

I'm overjoyed that Crimson Bikes has taken over the old Cannondale retail space. Some of my favorite staff are back as well! I work right next door, so it's super convenient for me (and a beautiful space for them!). 

The important part... I took my Cannondale in to get a tune-up and Addison did a really terrific job. My bike rides like new (maybe even better than new?). I'm also happy to report that all of the staff are friendly and honest (no bike shop attitude!). I will definitely be bringing my bike back to Crimson Bikes and look forward to buying accessories there too!

I asked for an estimate to repair curb rash to my wheels. I submitted pictures. Got no response. Sentry a text asking if they had received the pictures. Got a response asking me to send pictures of the whole wheel.   I did that and got an estimate of $1850 per wheel. Amazing. Others had quoted $100 a wheel. I asked if he thought we were replacing the wheels. Got no response. They obviously don't want the work. They could have been courteous and just said that. I'd never consider doing any work with these folks.

I had high expectations before arriving at Tresca. Maybe I shouldn't have - I would have been less disappointed. The hostess seating us was friendly and accommodated us by moving us from a table near a large group of diners to a high top table we wanted located near the open window in the bar section. The restaurant in general is a nice, cozy space. Our table offered us a good opportunity to people watch on a mild, pleasant summer evening.

The reason for the two stars is because the service was lacking. There was no management presence either to make sure things were running smoothly. Our waitress seemed a little overwhelmed, because perhaps she was new and maybe needed a little help but there was no one to really help her. She was apologetic and thanked us for our patience.  It did take us about 15 min. to get water. There was no silverware on the table. When our appetizer of Arancini arrived it nearly went to the table next to us because the server was unaware which table ordered it. We also had to wait for plates. 

A Lemon Drop martini and a glass of red wine (Barbera) were ordered. The martini was extra strong which was probably good since it might have taken too long to get a second one. The wine was just OK. We ordered the pork chop which was dry and the beef tenderloin which was fair - soft and juicy with a sauce which was decent but a bit too sweet. There was no seasoning at all on the mashed potatoes.

I will not be returning to Tresca. There are other restaurants in the North End to discover or return to - Taranta or Trattoria Di Monica, just to name a couple,  are better bets.

Good experience. 

If you are watching a less popular movie don't worry about getting there too early (just 20-30 mins at least for me on a Sat night). There will be plenty of spots! Screen is a great size and behind it were nice trees. 

They have popcorn and random snacks here but I didn't get any. Also people selling toys that light up for kids like they do on beach boardwalks. 

Bathrooms are fairly clean especially if you compare it to amusement park bathrooms. 

The phone number here on yelp is out of service. Definitely call this number if your car dies otherwise it might be hard to find you: tel:+14046273641 after calling, the person who jumps cars arrived in 20ish minutes which was perfect timing before next movie started. 

I feel like movies aren't as great as they used to be, but not the theater's fault. Great place for a first date or if you are starving and want to watch a movie away from your couch doing netflix and chill. ;) Bring all you can eat and enjoy! 

Only $9 for two movies and most cars are pretty cooperative and quiet so good experience. 

Till next time! 
Cherie

we wanted to thank the loot team so much for making our 1920s themed wedding amazing. we had a empty venue and they filled with vintage furniture. Anna created a men's room and a elegant room for the laddies, it was perfect . our guest had so much fun with the props and taking photos. the set up really created that intimate  feeling we were looking for and set the mood for the 20s . loot vintage rental we above and beyond our expectations .thank you so much for making our special day unforgettable and just amazing.  if we ever have a event that could use some decor with a Little vintage twist we will defiantly be calling you. 


thanks again


MR. and Miss Wheat

Like the name suggest!

What did I get
Parking...? I have parked her a number of times both uncovered and covered. I like the covered area, it is close to the front. The covered area just has a shelter over the car, it is no garage. But the uncovered area is very big and they have cameras all over and will be able to send someone to pick you up right at your car. They pick you up and they write your spot for you, make sure you take a picture or keep a record of it!

The lot is fairly near the airport. Takes about 15-20 mins to get there once you are on the bus. There are busses often, I never had to wait more than 5 mins to get on a bus. 

Environment
Most of the time I went at night, it was quite safe. I can't imagine how big the parking lot is, I have never experienced a shortage of parking space and you should be worried about being far because they do pick you up.

Niceness of Staff
The gate staff is relatively nice. The drivers are nice, they write down the spot you parked at and also take your luggage if needed.

Dollar
It wad 10.99 for covered and 8.99 for uncovered parking. They also give student discount! There is also employee and military discounts. My student discount was 10%

Yes?
Definitely my preferred place of parking if not at the airport. Once I go one place that is it! I don't really try other places cause this one has worked for me so far. No issues.

I have been golfing for just over 2 years. The team and process at golftec has helped me make significant improvements in my game. The ability to see a video of my swing in real time has been a great diagnostic tool. My coach, Van Johns, has a way of providing straight forward coaching to solve tough swing issues. He has been an excellent coach. I highly recommend golftec and Van for anyone who is ready to improve their game in a measurable way!

My friend and I agreed that had we not looked up this restaurant on Yelp, we would have surely walked right past it. The atmosphere is a cozy cafe with a handful of tables, but we were lucky not to have any wait by coming on a rainy weekday. 

As for the food, I immediately thought the brunch menu was unique for the Bulgarian flare. We shared two dishes - "Poached Eggs on English Muffin" with spinach and Vancouver's famous smoked salmon, topped with yogurt sauce; along with the "Veggie Fillo" with the yogurt sauce on the side for dipping and in order to maintain the crispiness of the Fillo. Both dishes came with a side of potatoes and yams.

As a brunch fanatic, I have become of a lover of any type of eggs Benedict. The poached eggs dish felt like a somewhat healthier version of the classic by replacing the usual rich hollandaise with the zippy, light yogurt sauce. I also really liked the yams (because I always end up opting for sweet potatoes over regular potatoes at any meal). The mix with the regular potatoes was a smart choice because yams are much sweeter than sweet potatoes - This way, I wasn't overwhelmed with the familiar candied, Thanksgiving flavor of yam. My friend enjoyed the veggie filo, which reminded us of a Greek spinach pie. 

The one downside to my meal is minor - my glass of water was lukewarm and a bit cloudy. Thank goodness the savory food that came after my initial drink made up for the lesser quality tap water.

I have been consulting with Leslie for about three years now. I have had private readings with her, energy work sessions, as well as attended her guided meditation group. Every interaction with Leslie is positive, healing, and uplifting experience. Her energy is clear, her intention is pure and she genuinely cares about you.  I kept a journal of every reading I received from Leslie and all of her predictions have been accurate. Her visions are true. Her intuition is correct. She can help you.

Several years ago I was referred to Brian through the Lawyer Referral Service. I was grasping at straws and not sure who to trust for my particular situation.

I feel so incredibly fortunate that the service referred me to Brian. He is intelligent, ethical, thorough and most of all KIND. He helped me work through my challenges in a manner that literally helped me get my life back on track. 

He was even helpful long after the fact when things popped up. He went above and beyond to help me and I am eternally grateful.

(...and don't feel bad if you can't pronounce his last name - it's "Jig Air")

Yes, five stars it is. I got a Craftmans power sander here new in the box for under $13.00 bucks because I had a $3 off coupon. The best part was that I had been looking for a power sander, but I was holding off because decent ones are pricey.  When I saw the price I could not believe, it felt like theft.  I have also found a STX Lacrosse stick, a fancy rolling bag, and awesome pair of mesh puma sneakers all or $10.00 or less here. I bought a Wilson's leather jacket for that retails for $300 for $20.00.  If you make a donation, the  donation receipt has a $3 off coupon for a purchase over $10.00.

I tried on line to set up the currency exchange on line but failed to execute four times for unknown reasons. They told me to go to travelex location at Lenox Square, 25 minutes away. I arrived at the window and no one was there as I waited 15 minutes. No apologies given when she returned. The exchange rate is horrible for euros. Wait till you get to a bank in Europe! $600 USD would have gotten me 469€ whereas currency XE app states 526€ which is 57 € less. No thank you.

Guys. Come on. This is just unsafe and I know you can do better. One of the basketball courts--Court #1--is warped, does this not concern you that you're putting athletes at risk? The floor rises up to a peak on the sidelines, then dips lower into the court. This is not safe or wise or professional. Fix this. We've watched athletes, parents and coaches trip over this court's warped boards. 

The bathrooms. So horribly gross you can smell them upon entering the building. Trash everywhere. Unsanitary, unflushed clogged toilets, toilet paper scraps all over the floor. No way will I use this facility.

There are at least two sets of bleachers that are broken. You've continued to use these despite the injury risk, & fans of teams who play here continue to sit on these because they remain available. Can you replace these? Is that an option? 

Finally, the broken glass in the fire extinguisher red case. Long daggers of broken glass barely hanging in place~~hanging over chairs where people sit! Glass pieces are on the floor around the extinguisher case. Do you need photos? This has been this way for weeks now. Broken shards of dagger-shaped glass hanging over our youth while they use your facility. Do you have building inspections? Safety standards? 

None of this is acceptable. Please clean up for the sake of the athletes who pay you to use your facility. I'll change my review when you clean this place up. 


UPDATE: 1 1/2 YEARS LATER and you guys STILL haven't fixed the court??? you're still allowing kids to practice on a warped court and charging teams for this? Maybe we need an inspector. Sounds like it's time! Unreal!!! How unsafe and negligent of you!

This is a Chinese style dessert house in a very good location on Robson.  It's very clean inside and has cute sprinkle of blingy lights that glow on the ground as you walk in.

I ordered the walnut soup with rice dumpling with sesame filling.  Problem?  That's what the menu says but immediately, you're told by waiter that he dumpling is just a plain rice dumpling without that amazing sesame filling.  

It pretty much ruined my experience there.  The soup was decent but with just a plain rice dumpling, the dessert was.....well: plain.  

No one goes to a dessert place to just order something that is plain.  I suggest the owner remove any items on the menu that cannot be ordered.  It ruins the customer's expectation.

So, yesterday I had that test you're supposed to get when you turn 50. If you don't know which one I'm talking about, you eventually will. Let's just say it involves a camera and some spelunking. 
The fun starts 24 hrs. prior with the prep. I found it somewhat ironic that last week I saw The Purge: Anarchy, and this week I lived through The Purge: Colonoscopy. Both were sh***y and left me feeling empty inside.
AG is a pretty well set up and efficient place. I was led to my room where I changed and got under a heated blanket, then the nurse got my history and started the IV. The Anesthesiologist, then the Anesthetist, both explained the process and off we went. A little Propofol (Milk of Amnesia) and I was out within around 20 seconds. I woke up back in my room, apparently saying "Now I know what a corn dog feels like." I recovered for 30 minutes and was walked to the car.
All in all a positive experience. As an RN, I know what to look for. The place does patient care and service VERY well.

Then it was time for a massive f**king sammich!!

After living here full time for 4 months. I had out of town company show up. Last night I was giving 72hours for me and my company from out of town to leave without warning. Apparently theres a 5 day stay. My friend from out of town now has to pack up and leave and now I am evicted myself. Ive alway paid on time and minded my own business but apparently thats not good enough.
Run stay at WalMart down the street avoid this money hungry pit

I'm impressed that Boston's only PC/gaming cafe is a proper establishment with lots of space and a clean modern vibe. I went twice within the first few months of opening and the staff were very helpful. They definitely hired knowledgeable and passionate staff. There's a solid number of games on the PCs. I wish that the PC and console booth hours were interchangeable. It's cheaper to buy hours in bulk (~$6/7) but it's hard to decide how many when they have to be separated. It's also a little hard to play older console games because the quality of an old game on the huge HD TV screen gets tiring fast. 

Since I don't own a gaming PC or console I would be happy to go back. The place is very popular on weekends and especially at night. I assume all the students in the area will keep Balance Patch busy. They also serve food but the prices weren't enticing for me. Overall, I would go back once in awhile, but it's better with a larger group for the console booths.

I had been using another dispensary for the last year, but decided to look around a bit.  I wound up spending a lot of money at the Tree House.  One of my purchases was a vape pen, consisting of a battery and several cartridges for it, with the assurance that, although they were different brands, they would definitely work in the same battery.  A month or so later I found that one of them would NOT work, and they refused to  exchange it.  They told me to just buy another battery.  But I was told it would work with the battery they sold me. My other dispensary stands behind their products and gives great service.  The Vista Wellness Center isn't as glamorous, but their prices are better and they have integrity.  I had purchased a bad cartridge from them and they immediately gave me another, no questions asked.  The Tree House has a cool 'vibe',  but I am done with their poor customer service.

Do you have Jury duty?? Don't freak out, it's easy. Judge was funny, officers were very professional and kind, the only bad part of this experience was the waiting. If you don't know where to go they have what judges are on what floors inside the elevators. I wouldn't even bother looking at the TV screens to find your name, it takes too long. I got there around 8:15 and left around 1:30. It's easiest to find this building if you go to the corner of W 10th Street & San Antonio St. Just follow other people walking in haha.. that's what I did.

This is probably one of the coolest places I've went for entertainment. It reminded me of bowling, if bowling was fun . Great casual atmosphere. Great instruction from staff so you know what you're doing. We liked that we could take our own food and drinks in. My husband thinks Im the best bc I took him somewhere he could throw weapons. Out group consisted of two couples. The women had almost as much fun as the men. Do not miss the chance to go here!

Michele Locke is the most thorough and professional, very knowledgeable about family law. More than an attorney, she is also a good advisor, and counselor. She helped me in the divorce, explained about the pros & cons of my decision and guided me towards right path. Whenever I was in high stress, she released my stress with her suggestions, and finally gave me the peace of mind. Final Word: It is really a wise decision to hire Mrs. Locke.  She is very helpful & I can assure you will get out of issues happily.

I have used Amini Conant for my business and personally. They have helped to advise my company on contracts and general guidance. They have helped us to avoid a lot of potentially sticky legal situations through their knowledge of business law. They are currently helping me on a lawsuit against Volkswagen for my TDI. They communicate well and are very clear with their expectations and the time tables associated. Their office environment is fantastic and it is inspiring to see a place that is filled with people working their butts off for their clients.

This office has the most lovely color scheme, green and charcoal gray, with modern decor mixed with old wood floors and other features.  Chairs are comfortable, with snuggle blankets for warmth, and the room is surrounded by light and beauty. Also TV and other electronics are available. The Feng Shui is outstanding. . . and so is the service. I was totally cared for, from the moment I entered. After my IV was inserted -- painlessly, I might add, with a small diameter needle -- the nurse was available for all my needs. I look forward to returning for more treatments and I give this Onus location top recommendation.

I have to say, the way Gene Kelly approaches teaching music - with enthusiasm, dedication and an open mind - it has made all the difference for my children and their continuity with music. We first started my son with Piano a few years ago with a more regimented approach - yikes, was not fun for him nor us. 

My son is now 11 and is involved with 2-3 sports, homework and so forth - but he continues to progress in Piano because Gene makes it fun, enjoyable and quite simply a great experience. For example, my son had a talent show in his school and he worked with Gene to play a really cool piece that was brilliant! 

My daughter is 8 and naturally she is always interested in what her brother is up to. So, we added lessons for her after my son. She likes to sing songs she hears today - so Gene would learn the song and they would jam together! Taylor Swift, Katy Perry, Bruno Mars - wow.

The recitals are great too - formal but relaxed and what a great diverse mix of students doing all sorts of music - rock n roll, guitar solos, piano, wind instruments. I think Gene just makes it a pleasure for the kids and the families - he is so easy to work with and what an incredible and modern way to keep music a big part of today's children. We've been with Gene for a year now, looking forward to what the next one brings!

I recently contracted their services to take a small group from Austin to Fredericksburg for the day. Ray and Don at Austin Wheelchair are phenomenal! I'm a Physical Therapist at a Rehab hospital in town, and Ray and Don have gone out of their way on multiple occasions to help our patients get into proper fitting custom wheelchairs. I recently had a patient who was needing further surgery, so I wasn't confident in designing a custom chair for him until after his upcoming procedure. I was worried about this C6-7 patient with a spinal cord injury going home in a clunker of a chair that he couldn't push, maintain his balance, or pressure relief in. Ray went ABOVE AND BEYOND to provide him with a loaner Quickie 2 chair that had rim grips, dump, a rigid backrest, and a pressure relieving cushion so he could continue making therapeutic progress upon his discharge. I love using Ray and Don for my wheelchair & DME orders because they aren't constantly trying to up-sell you, they are honest, and they genuinely love helping people. Thanks for all you do, Austin Wheelchair!

I began my CBD journey only recently as a last resort for attempting to handle my anxiety. I didn't know much about it, and I wasn't really sure if it would work. I was looking around for a quality product, and someone I follow on Instagram mentioned they were trying Restart. I purchased the Relax dropper bottle, and began experimenting with dosage. This has made the biggest difference in my lifestyle where I thought nothing could. I can drink coffee now without worrying about the wrenching anxiety that comes with it. I can fall asleep and stay asleep easier now. I have an easier time in public, and it's even given me a bit more confidence since I'm....well, relaxed, lol. I told myself I would shop around after Restart but now I am so satisfied I truly don't want/need to. I'm looking forward to trying the new products that were just released.

Column Health saved my life! I have been a patient of theirs for over two years. I was addicted to Xanax due to a MD (not associated with Column) over prescribing them. He then retired, and I tried to wean myself off. Bad idea. I started then self medicating with other substances, and was going towards a downward spiral. I found Column through a friend, and made an appointment. They weaned me off of Xanax the correct way, and then prescribed the proper medication that I needed to address my mental health issues. So I didn't feel the need to self medicate. I have no need or want a Xanax, or any other controlled or illegal substance. I engage in my therapy. My therapist and I developed an escape plan to get away from my abusive ex husband, taught me coping skills, anger management, and organizing my thoughts. Most importantly, they taught me self love and that there IS life after addiction. I am a true believer that addiction starts with mental health. If you address the mental health issue, you will not feel the need to self medicate with your drug of choice. I engage in my therapy, I do not miss appointments. They have truly turned my life around. I am forever thankful! They have inspired me to join the fight in addiction, and tell MY OWN story in hopes I can teach and reach one. You have to be serious about recovery. Otherwise honestly, this is not a good program for you. You have to be absolutely ready to stop! As long as you engage in therapy, and go to all your appointments. Then this program will work for you. But if you're not serious about it, then you're wasting your own time and theirs as well. Thank you Column Health! I'm forever in debt!

My wife and I own a business in Round Rock and we were remodeling our new location when the stucco contractor that we had hired informed us that he had gotten very behind and would not be able to meet our timeline. I was in a bad spot and Lee at Lone Star was a life saver. They gave us a reasonable price but better than that they came in and performed the work asap and the work they did was absolutely fantastic. I could not have had a better experience and I would highly recommend them to anyone who wants a very professional job and superior treatment.

I had an enjoyable time at this mountain. It isn't the biggest ski area I have been to, but it was literally minutes from my hotel in North Vancouver. I got lucky and made my trip the day after a good snowfall. Even so, I did hit some icy spots. Talking to some of the employees, they said this is often a problem. They also mentioned that this has been a bad winter for snowfall and they usually get more snow than Whistler. Regardless, I found some powder and was happy. The mountain was big enough to keep me entertained until I got tired enough to stop for the day but not so big that I was completely lost on it. 

It was pretty overcast when I was here, but the sky cleared a few times revealing gorgeous views of Vancouver and Vancouver bay. 

Overall, I would say that there is something here for all skill levels. However, more advanced riders will probably be looking for something more after a few days of skiing this mountain.

This is a great State Park and very popular, if you don't arrive early you could be turned away since the park more often than not in the summer months reaches capacity. There are plenty of things to do once you arrive go left and find the swimming hole choose right and take a leisurely walk on the raised wooden boardwalk, no matter the direction you take you won't be disappointed and have full access to everything.

There are lots of amenities include food and refreshments along with some interactive displaying a ton of information.

Since we weren't prepared to swim or kayak we didn't a lot, of walking and found a Penny Smashing Machine woot woot!!!

It took me awhile to visit Steve's cheese bar after his move WAY WAY far away from where I live. (he was less than 10 mins from home previously).  But I'm happy for him, it's a much better space, I very much like the look and vibe of the shop.  In addition to the different cheeses, they now also serve food, beer and wine.
We dropped by on a weekend mid-afternoon and see it bustling the whole time we were there.  Even though they're busy, they didn't hesitate in letting us sample the different beers on tap before ordering.  They also have tons of bottled beers if the drafts don't strike your fancy.
We ordered the cheese plate (3 different kinds of cheese with a side of beet chutney), meat plate (coppa, mortadella & salami) with a side of pickled veggies, and cheese fondue with super crispy toasts.  It's not the traditional fondue, but it's very good.
I could definitely see myself hang out here on weekends if it were not for the fact that it's WAY WAY far away now.... yes, I might be slightly bitter.

I'm new to ATL and wanted Indian food ordered-in on a Sat. night. I used Grubhub to order, even though the restaurant delivers their food directly. Next time I'll try calling the restaurant to order or order online from their website to save the extra fees. 

All I can say is good, "WOW!" I pretty much always order saag paneer, chicken tikka masala, raita, mango chutney, paratha and rice. This time I also ordered Mulligatawny soup. Their menu selection was extensive, including all dishes in lamb, beef, chicken, goat and seafood and they give you the option to order it mild, medium, hot. 

The portions were generous, enough for 2 big meals or 3 small ones. Came really well wrapped, no spillage and HOT. Grubhub said they would deliver in 60-70 minutes and the food was delivered within 35 minutes:) BIG bonus points. And they followed the complicated directions to my unit in a loft complex. Thank you;)

The dishes were all mildly and deliciously spiced as requested, the masala sauce delicious and the saag so fresh with great hand pressed cheese squares. The raita was a little thin on the yogurt...The paratha was a large size and the rice perfectly cooked. 

There was a coupon on Grubhub that I redeemed for a complimentary vegetable pakora...mostly sweet potatoe and carrot, (I think), and that was a treat with the mint sauce and chutney. The whole meal made me feel like I was eating a dessert and now I can't wait to have leftovers tomorrow. Huge fan!
