His team came back every day to check the levels of moisture in the basement. They didn't finish the project until I was completely satisfied that the basement was dried out. I would recommend 911 Restoration to anybody who has had water issues in their basement.

Yelp should have a ZERO STAR option because this place really deserves it. So many people including myself have been screwed by the people working here. It seems being incompetent is a prerequisite to be eligible to work at TMB. They never answer phone calls, their email replies, which comes a week after you contact them, never has any new information for you and going there in person is no less frustrating because you can't talk to anyone but those two  antiquated robots at the window who couldn't be bothered. The board took a job it couldn't handle and unfortunately people like me can't work due to suspension or delay in issuing license. It's been about 4 months since I first applied and all they do is keep asking me for the same damn documents. Either they are too lazy to look or they have managed to loose it somehow which makes sense since "incompetency" is the gold standard here. I know this place and the people who work here will never understand what we have to go through when all of a sudden we can't do what we do for a living. The higher ups within the healthcare organizations and the medical board are quite happy splitting the profits so I suppose they will never have to worry about being unemployed. So I can only hope that they all die soon and are replaced by somewhat better employees.

I've been back for a couple of events and had a really good time.  The events are unique (like Astronomy on Tap), and their beer selection was filled with quality, Ohio beers.  They don't have a ton of different beers, but they have some fantastic beers.  I had a few sips of mead, and I'm warming up to the idea a bit.  I probably just need to find something that I like.  

Service was good.  I will definitely come back for special events, but I'm not sure I'd be drawn here for anything else.

In my opinion, the best way to see Vancouver is by bicycle, and these guys can make that happen. We rented two bikes for 4 days, for way less than what it costs at other places. And the bikes were in great condition too! Not some rusty pieces of junk with brakes that squeal that other bike shops rent out for 3x as much.

The best part was the rack on the back of the bike. With some bungee cords that the shop provided (and a little finesse) we managed to haul our luggage with the bikes to the place we were staying. They stored our luggage for us in the morning until our place was ready for check-in in the afternoon.

The employees were friendly for the most part. I would get there early because when we came back in the afternoon there were no bikes left.

A wonderful experience! I cannot say enough good things about RBA, especially Dr. Toledo and his nurse Krista, though the entire staff is top notch. I started at ACRM but had a disappointing experience with my doctor's nurse, so switched to RBA. 

I had unexplained infertility and Dr. Toledo was confident he could help my husband and I get pregnant, even though I wasn't sure it would work. We are now the parents of a beautiful one month old girl and are forever grateful to Dr. Toledo and his team. 
If you are struggling to get pregnant, make an appointment with Dr. Toledo asap--he is worth it and will make you a parent!

About a week and a half ago in preparation for an extended road trip, I called Latham Auto to see if they could do a thorough check of my vehicle to make sure it was road-worthy. I was told by Dan to bring it in at 9 a.m. on Wednesday 7/25 (today, which was a week and a half after the phone call). The date was cutting it close to my planned trip but I wanted to bring the vehicle into Latham as I trusted them on previous service. I arranged a pick up ride for the scheduled date. On a whim (intuition?), I called Latham right before I headed out only to be  told they were busy and couldn't get to it until Monday. What? Did I make an appointment - yes, I did and I a leaving for my trip on Tuesday. Well, I was obviously upset since I MADE AN APPOINTMENT for this service a full week and a half in advance. Dan wasn't apologetic at all! His excuse: we have a lot of work to get through. Fine. You can't keep to your promised schedule but worse, you weren't considerate enough to call me - like yesterday - and tell me that you won't be able to keep the appointment. In the meantime, my ride, who had driven 45 minutes to get to Buda from Austin, had already arrived. If Dan had at least been apologetic instead of making an excuse, I wouldn't be quite as upset (although upset enough). Bad customer service like this can ruin a business. I will never patronize this business again.

What a miserable experience. Myself and my family have visited phantom for past several years as a fathers day celebration. Always take my daughters and we all choose sifferent fireworks to celebrate our independence day together. This year was no different until we arrived after 45 min drive to get there. We were informed children cannot accompany adults into store. This was a first in all of our years of shopping here. Needless to say, will return home and find other things to do that have not been banned because of willfull ignorance. This country is burning, and this is just another small example. Have seen many be turned away while piling back in the car to head home. Website has no information on this so dont waste your time.

Horrible. Awful. They like to remind you over and over how if you cancel they get to keep your money...but when they cancel with no notice and offer no good solutions you're screwed. If you're sick and depend on meds, go to a place that will actually help you and not tell you that they can't help because of corporate "protocol".

And this is just the latest issue. The last 2 interactions I've had with DocMJ prior to this 3rd and final one we're just as bad. I was hoping they were just isolated incidents but it's clear that they do not have the patients best interest at heart.

I went to get a Spanish book and there were no copies in stock. I had my name written down, came back later that afternoon to pick up the book, and it had been sold to another customer. I called ahead the next morning, and after having to call three times due to a lack of answering, was told to pick up the book at 10am. Went at 10am and it had not been bound, so I asked to wait there and was told it wouldn't be done until 2pm. Had my name written down again and was promised I could pick up a copy. Went back to the store at 4:30pm to pick it up, and it was not there. Very slow service and not accommodating or helpful at all. Professors always say how they give a certain number of books to be printed and Gnomon Copy always prints less of them than requested. Frustrated because I have homework due on a deadline and have had to walk here four times without success.

I had heard how the receptionist,Olga, was a rude person. I never (fortunately) spoke with her till today. Till now, I had spoken with the owner - Vitale before and he was pleasant. But Olga, oh my god!!! So rude and extremely unprofessional. She has no idea of how to speak to a customer!!! The only reason I even gave it 2 stars was for Manny. He is a great teacher. 
But save yourself some trouble and absolutely avoid talking with Olga. Just ask to speak directly to the owner.

I did not have the same experience as the previous posters regarding wait time. I had to reschedule my appointment the day before, and they were able to move my appointment from 9am to 2pm. I also forgot the paperwork I was given beforehand, so I was prepared to wait awhile (based on Yelp reviews). However, I was called back maybe five minutes after completing my paperwork and was able to see the doctor shortly after completing the preliminary tests with the nurses. The only thing I would advise is be prepared to have your eyes dilated, as there is a sign at the office saying they dilate at pretty much every appointment.

Original Date: August 17, 2013

Me and my friend visited the Boston Public Garden just to ride the Swan Boats (only $3 per person), which is operated by someone peddling in the back around the lovely pond where you can see ducks, turtles, two beautiful swans and the breathtaking scenery. 

Another popular statue in the Public Garden is the Make Way for Ducklings which comes from a children story book. 

Didn't get to walk around much but it reminded me of home in NYC "Central Park" =)

Okay, so I was introduced to Balance over a year ago as I had them do chair massages at an event of mine and everyone loved them. I, unfortunately, did not get to experience them during the event but kept in touch and realized how integrated they were in the community. I hosted a Yelp CMYE at their location in Dec and finally got a taste of the chair massage by Tony, it was FAB! We also got a tour of their facilities in College Park along with an intro to acupuncture. 

I never received acupuncture before so it intrigued me and after the sample ear test I left there with my first appointment scheduled! I headed back to see Michelle for my very first, official acupuncture treatment. Michelle is so warming, welcoming and calm that you just want to hug her. We chatted about my history and problem areas and she had me lay down on their heated, automatic table and she went to work on my front and back. There is calming music as well so even though you may not feel the calming effects immediately like you do during a massage, this is your down time with yourself while you relax and let the acupuncture do it's work. 

My first problem area we really focused on was my lower back as I deeply bruised my butt bone years ago and now when I sit for a long time on a plane or in the movies, it starts to ache. A week after my first treatment, I was on a plane home to PA and back and neither flight was a bother... WHAT?!!? AMAZING! So I went back and we worked on my right arm that gives me issues and literally since I have left... no pain! We also are paying attention to my head and neck since I hold all my tension in there but I am also trying a new diet which is not really helping with my headaches so those results will probably take a few more sessions. Overall... amazing and I can't wait to go again, Michelle is a magic worker!

I also had my first hour massage yesterday from Sarah. She is so sweet and calming as well, I wonder if they pump calming serum into the air ducts there =) We focused on my head, neck, shoulders and sciatic nerves. She went pretty deep and it was painful in such an amazing way that I literally had to stop myself from drooling. My shoulders feel good today but no pain so that is a plus. My neck is still tight but I need a LOT of work on that area =)

Overall, this place delivers!! Yes, you are paying for something well above your "Massage Envy" experiences, you are paying for treatment and bodywork, not just a massage. Don't expect a spa type place here either, they are more on the treatment side and each room is separate from each other which helps with relaxing. Huge shoutout to Deb and the entire staff... keep up the great work and community love!

Fortune was smiling on me the day I wandered into this bike shop.

The manager Dan suggested I try an ebike, and it was easily the nicest bike I've ever ridden. (Even the helmet and lock were remarkably nice.) So much fun!! I buzzed all around town, up and down the riverfront trail, and across Portland's many bridges. I liked the bike so much I went back and rented it the next week, taking it out on the Leif Erikson trail through Forest Park. Service was exceptionally friendly both times.

My third time in the shop was a weekend, and the guys working that day were also friendly but a bit disorganized. It took a while to get the bike, and it was... well, shoot, it was just a regular rental bike. The lock was really cool though, and it was still worth it for the convenience of being able to get around town on two wheels. 

BikeHub is tops on my list for the next time I'm in Portland!

We rented a jet ski from this company for Spring Break. The jet ski itself kept malfunctioning while we were using it, so we were only able to use it for a couple of hours on the first day of rental. On that day we did have an accident and the jet ski hit the dock and caused some body damage.

When we returned the jet ski we notified them of the damage and told them we'd gladly compensate for the damage but we also wanted them to take into consideration that the unit kept malfunctioning and so we weren't able to use the ski for the time we paid for it, hoping they'd credit the day we didn't operate it from the repairs.

The next thing we know they charged our card for $1000 and have refused to respond to our requests for an invoice or estimate for the repairs. Were were told they received a quote for repairs, by phone, that included damage that was there before us renting the ski. We have before and after pictures of the jetski. We're currently disputing charges with our card and will take it to the next level if necessary. 

It is very, very shady and extremely bad business to not provide copies of the estimate and at least allow us the opportunity to get a second opinion on the repair work. Instead he just charged our card and is ignoring all communication. We weren't trying to screw him and told them we'd pay for damages, but I'd appreciate the same courtesy in return.

Beware of this company and their unethical business practices.

Christi is an awesome and professional American accent teacher. My company has some educational fund for employees so my manager suggested me to use it for speech training. I was fortunate to find Christi. Initially, I chose her program because of the location (Central Square) and time (after work hours). She has very dedicated teaching methodology which helps me improve my spoken English a lot, especially in public speaking skills, awareness of mistakes, key features of English (intonation, emphasis of key words, pronunciation of specific sounds), most important of all, the methodology she taught me for continuous practice. And also, she has good personality and is easy to work with. I sincerely recommend Christi and her American speech coaching program.

A true rarity. A city-owned racing facility that creates jobs, has a net positive income to city coffers, provides a venue for police training, and gives drivers a safe facility to learn advanced driving techniques and participate in competitive events.

This is not a track for the sole benefit corporate executives and high rollers... it is a facility staffed by locals and used by grassroots regional racers. Thanks to the track staff and city leaders who have created and enhanced such a great facility right here in town, and now accessible by public transit!

My family went on an evening airboat tour with Seth. It was an awesome experience that I would recommend to friends and family. The tour included an hour long transit through waterways and swampy areas. We saw tons of alligators of all sizes. There was also a lot of other cool wildlife to see. At $65/50 per adults/kids, the price seemed fair and was a good value for what you got. 

Seth was friendly and knowledgeable. I especially liked that he is the owner/ operator rather than going through a separate tour organization company. 

They take credit cards.

We had a great experience with Martel Tree Removal. They were professional when handling business and their pricing is more affordable than I was expecting. They did a great job removing our trees as well as my neighbors who also used them. We were especially impressed by their clean up. I was expecting a mess of the ground where the trees were removed but their guys got all the branches and limbs off the ground, no clean up for us at all. I would highly recommend calling Martel before calling anywhere else.

Made it a road trip and drove up from Miami.    Wasn't sure what to expect.   Right away the facility is first rate and impressive.  Clean, lots of room,  plenty of gear and the latest machines.   Even a cafe for relaxing....Apres' Ski.     We brought a beginner with us that had been getting a little discouraged with expensive Resort lessons that were pretty much non-productive.   She was nervous and apprehensive at first (which lasted about 2 minutes) Her instructor was re-assuring,  professional and extremely knowledgeable.   Her results were immediate.   After the first session,  she was pumped and  anxious to come back for more.  (which we did the next day)
Two more sessions later and she is "skiing".  I am not kidding. She will now be able to ski the mountain.  Changed my mind completely about the benefits of indoor lessons.   Much more  one on one direct teaching with instant results and improvement.   Throw in the much more reasonable rates and this is the "go to" method for learning to ski.   
 Even as a more advanced skier, It was a real workout for me and I learned new moves I was  never able to do over my many years of skiing.   
   A lot of fun and very productive with a very friendly and inviting staff.   

We will definitely be returning.

It's always difficult to find YOUR pizza place when moving to a new town. But I can confidently say that after trying different places over the course of a year that this is THE place. 

This is good Italian-style pie, not the (sorry) inferior Greek-style. My family takes advantage of the $6.99 cheese pizza deal quite often including ordering a dozen pizzas for my daughter's birthday.

Also, as an obscure side note, there is a $10 minimum for credit card purchases. But instead of refusing to take a card like SO many places, they simply explain that there will be a (reasonable) surcharge added. Every place should do this instead of alienating and angering customers who prefer to not carry cash.

If I could give this place zero stars i would. This place was TOO over priced for their food and it's not even filling. I ordered chicken pasta and they waited until after everyone was served to tell me that all of their chicken was spoiled. They messed up another persons meal. The other injustice was the OVER PRICED meatball sub. The charged us 11 dollars for a sandwich that had 3 meatballs and 2 slices of cheese, no sauce. Firehouse subs charges 6.49 for their meatball sub and theirs are two times bigger and has sauce. Lastly, my friends ordered filled pasta with lobsters, which cost 18 dollars. When the dish came out their was only 4 ravioli! 

Overall, do not go to this place, you will get robbed.

this company is recommended by Costco. don't buy it. not worth the hassle. after sending everything they asked for, they closed my account. when i called to have it reopened they said it was because I hadn't returned their calls so they couldn't prove it was "me". mind you, I had applied through the Costco website, sent a copy of my license and multiple emails from my business account. I was on hold for one A total of 3.75 hours to try to get it resolved. after closing, they then went into my checking account and took $500 for a machine I didn't want or orde, without telling me first. 

I shipped it back after having to call Costco to get relief and they are now saying it will take 7 to 10 business days to refund. mind you. they got their money in 8 hours when they closed my account, but from call to Costco to refund it will take nearly 4 weeks. they truly only care about covering their asses instead of customer service. it's like a cable company from the 80s, mixed with a grain of telecom from the 90s.  stay away.

When I first heard about Samantha Hess, I've always wanted to give this place a try.  I visited family in the Portland area and since I was nearby I decided I'd pay a visit to Samantha since I had the opportunity available.  The past few years, I've had some rough times and after losing a woman I fell in love with 2 years ago and almost started a relationship but then dumped me and went back to her ex, it really impacted me big time and I still get the grudge from time to time.  After telling part of the story to Samantha, she was able to help give me comfort and I felt so relaxed when we cuddled up and I was thinking of the session with Sam whenever the grudge would come to me and it helps fight off the grudge, even afterwards I would think of the time I spent with Sam.  When first meeting Sam in person, she greets me and gives me a nice warm hug.  And after the session, we also hugged and she gave me a goodbye hug too.  We were in the galaxy room, which was perfect as it was not too bright or too dark.  It was the perfect theme for me, I really enjoyed it.  Samantha is awesome and I would definitely love to see her again.  If you need comfort and someone to cuddle with, I recommend this place!

So I've never written a review for a funeral home before...and I really don't know what all to say. I know that this funeral home is pretty well known, and the men who assisted me once I entered were very nice and helpful. The viewing room for the person I was viewing was a lot smaller than I expected, but I'm sure they probably have bigger rooms. I actually ended up being a "funeral crasher." Because the person who I went to view was not who I thought it was going to be, I didn't even know them and don't ever recall seeing them before. The most awkward situation ever!!! But that's a whole nother story.

This is a wonderful store for teachers or if you just have little ones in your life.  The staff is super friendly and helpful and the store is organized in a way that makes sense for shoppers.  They have specials everyday which will help you save.   My nephew loves anything I get for him there, and it's all educational!  My kindergarten class is filled with posters, pocket charts, and supplies from this store.  It's a one stop shopping spot for new teachers!!

After taking my dog to Pupcakes for over a year, I decided last week to find somewhere new. I had noticed their care had been slipping and did not feel that my dog (or really most of the dogs) were given attention, as no one seemed to actually be watching them when I returned to pick my dog up. I brought my concerns to the owner and was met with excuses and no action and was essentially told that it was not their fault that my dog was not in the fenced in area (where the dogs play) and that she was right next to their front door (where she easily could have run out) when I came to pick her up. 

Instead of responding promptly, she discussed the matter with another customer of hers, and she told me so herself. I am very disappointed that efforts were not made to rectify the situation, as I really considered myself and my pup to be loyal customers. The staff overhaul they seem to have experienced lately also seems to have impacted their environment.

Was very excited to try the dank looking food, but sadly it was very much not that great. Some of the items seemed pre frozen? I really hope not- maybe they can shed some light on that here. The flavor of the meat dumplings was super good, but the dough of the stuffed bread was undercooked and we couldn't tell if parts were cheese or dough. They were undercooked dough. Just feels a little careless. Also the interior smells like old rat piss! It's an old building and I've live in houses that smell from rats, and this smelled like they used to have a rat problem. I'm sure they addressed it but the smell is hard to get rid of. Just my input.

Lauren B. and I got 4 vodka/cranberry drinks for $12. What UP. Double fisting is probably your best bet to avoid lines. Not that I'm advocating binge drinking.. errr. yeah. The bartenders inside were okay (I didn't use the outside bar at all). They didn't really make eye contact and were probably a little surly for having to deal with the Dancing on the Charles crowd inside of their regular chain-smoking/Keno players. As a dive bar, it ranks but the lighting is far too bright and unflattering. Can someone turn it down a notch? Thankyee. 

As for DOTC.. it was fun.. considering the little time I spent outside dancing and getting bitten by mosquitoes. Hey.. the drinks were cheap and the place was air conditioned. Whoops. haha.. Make sure to pack some toilet paper, antibacterial, bug spray (they had the decent smelling kid but ran out), cash.. and you should be all set! Maybe a flashlight if you're scared of dark port-o-potties. The music was FANTASTIC but the area kind of reminded me of what my junior high dance would have been like had it been placed in the wilderness.

I needed some passport photos taken for an Irish passport and spent time calling around town because the requirements are different that for the US.  Other places seemed confused when I asked about a foreign passport or they wanted to charge twice as much as for US passport photos.  Not here.  The lady working behind the counter was extremely helpful and knowledgeable.  When she found out I needed them for Ireland she knew instantly knew all the requirements from the expression on my face to the size of the photo.  After taking the pictures she was even kind enough to pull out the official Irish requirements (which she had on file) to make sure that the photos were correctly sized and posed.  And all of this took less than 5 min and cost $10.  I couldn't recommend this place more highly for either US or foreign passport photos.

Leonard has been representing both myself and my business for over 5 years. He is absolutely the best attorney I have ever worked with and I would highly recommend him to anyone. I have always felt that Leonard truly cares about me as a person and he always make time for me no matter how big or small my issue is.  Leonard and his staff are very knowledgeable, professional and quick to respond.  With Leonard representing you, I can guarantee you will get the best possible outcome or resolution!

If it were not for Vanessa and Jen (the store supervisor and district manager, respectively) stepping up and fixing things, and for Jason just being a nice guy and doing what he could for me and treating me with respect,  I would be contacting the Attorney General and filing a complaint.
On December 4th of last year, I went in to make a Money Gram payment on a car title loan.  I wasn't very familiar with Money Gram and how to send one, but I had specific written instructions including a "receipt code" from the lender that I was told would be all I needed.   Akouvia was on duty at ACE Cash Express that evening.  When I gave her the information I had, she behaved as though I was asking too much of her.  She said she didn't understand what I wanted though I repeated myself several times, showed her the receipt code and address of the lender, etc.  I had been in there before to make the first couple Money Gram payments and it wasn't a big deal.  But Akouvia seemed dismissive and bothered by the fact that I was asking her to do this for me,  and so I asked to speak with her supervisor.
She basically blew me off when I asked her that.  She did call someone, I wasn't sure if it was her supervisor or not, but she stayed on the phone with them, and her body language was that of someone who was annoyed with me and the whole process.   I kept telling her that Vanessa (her supervisor) helped me before and knew what to do, but Akouvia basically ignored my requests to try and get ahold of her.   When she (Akouvia) finally got of the phone and finished the transaction she told me to just hit the green button and finished the Money Gram.   She lightened up a bit when I told her I was sorry but it was very frustrating and I just wanted to make my payment.  And, in her defense, she had NO OTHER STAFF AND THE WAITING ROOM WAS PACKED.    But I thought at least my bill was paid.  
So, fast forward to this week:    I discovered that my payment from that day never posted and had accrued a late fee (and this is a car title loan, very high interest).  The rep at the lender suggested I contact the Money Gram rep.  So I returned to ACE Quick Cash on SE 119th.   The district manager just happened to be there doing an audit and she took a look at my receipts and after about forty minutes of combing them over, discovered that the receipt from December 4th (the day that I had my run in with Akouvia) had someone else's name as the sender "Randall Pyle" or something like that.   Jen, the District Manager called the Money Gram headquarters and then told me sorry for the mistake and that she was going to take care of it and have a talk with Akouvia.   Unfortunately I didn't have my full account number so she asked that I return the next evening with that information so she could fix things for me.   
SO   I returned the next evening and Akouvia happened to be working, as well as another staff named Jason.   When I came into the store with my full account number as requested, Jason said he had Vanessa , their immediate supervisor, on the phone for me.   Vanessa told me over the phone that she wouldn't be able to help me, even with my full account number,  something about her having to re contact Money Gram, and asked me if I could come back again tomorrow (which would be a third trip into ACE Quick Cash just to try and get this issue resolved).   I told Vanessa I'd already missed an evening class , and that I had to work and was not able to take any more time off, that this was their mistake and I wanted it fixed.     She asked me to make an additional copy of my loan account number and address (while I was still there ) so after I got off the phone I waited for Akouvia, who was not helping anyone else at this point , to simply make the copy.  So after I got off the phone I waited for Akouvia, who was working that evening and had no other customer at this point. 
THEN JUST AS I WAS ABOUT TO TELL HER HELLO, I'M STANDING RIGHT HERE, ANOTHER CUSTOMER CUT IN FRONT OF ME AND SHE STARTED HELPING THEM!   AND I HAD BEEN STANDING RIGHT THERE, OBVIOUSLY. 
.
So I interrupted and said "um Hi,  I've been waiting and all I need is a copy made for Vanessa, (to correct the mistake made by Akouvia!!)   and she acted again like I was bothering her,  and said "I don't understand what you want"     ALL I ASKED HER WAS TO MAKE A COPY!   Anyway sorry this is so long but Akouvia was the one who made the initial mistake then continued to treat me rudely.    I just needed to vent!

Vanessa apologized and said she would "try and do this over the phone".  So , finally,  the next day she called me and said they will correct everything and get the payment posted.  TOTAL OF THREE TRIPS TO ACE Q C, ~4 HOURS OF MY TIME, ONLY TO BE GIVEN ATTITUDE BY THE VERY PERSON WHO MADE THE MISTAKE IN THE FIRST PLACE.   Sorry this is long but just needed to vent.  LESSON:  EVERYONE KEEP YOUR RECEIPTS AND READ THE FINE PRINT!

Peggy

This is what a good dive shop should feel like -- don't bother going anywhere else in Austin. 

I have only been in a couple times but they always remember my name, ask about my trips, and are just so dang passionate about diving. 

I mean these folks grin and smile as they get into drysuits for a murky lake. Part of making diving awesome is the family that comes along with it and whether it comes to courses or purchasing gear, scubaland is where you should do it! 

So glad to finally find a decent shop in Austin.

I wavered between two- and three-stars...two seems a bit harsh, but three is too much.  I go to this location because it's convenient for my work, but if I've got more time, I go to Compass Coffee a little further away and Brewed if I have even more time.  The ambiance is fine and the staff couldn't be any nicer, but my usual cappuccino orders are very hit-and-miss depending upon who's making them.  I never  thought I'd EVER utter the words that I'd actually prefer Starbucks over theirs just because Starbucks is at least consistent and I know what I'm getting.  Yeah, yeah...insert appropriate snarky Starbucks comments here.  I'll still patronize this location and I look forward to hopefully more consistency at some point, but they (as some others have said in here) are not my first choice.

Teresa Market is located by Oak Square on Washington Street.  It is a small market/convenience store stocked with fresh vegetables, shelf stable items, and chilled drinks.  It also has a counter where Mexican and Guatemalan dishes are made to order.  For eating in, there are 3 tables and 4 counter seats in the back where you may sit as you watch a Spanish show up on their flat screen tv.

I was here to grab an early dinner before heading over to my next stop, but I wasn't exactly hungry yet.  Their menu board had tacos, but they seemed to come 3 to an order.  I also like variety.  And the veggies that were grilled for the customer preceding me looked quite colorful.

After some discussion with the fellow behind the counter, who turned out to be the owner of this establishment, I ended up with a meal of off menu selections: a single pork belly taco $2.50, a half portion of plantains $1.65, and a side of grilled vegetables $2.50.  I got my fat splurge, my sweet, and my healthy, all in one.  And he got a happy customer!

The taco was well filled and satisfying.  Though I opted for the mild salsa, there was still a kick that was tamed by the accompanying cabbage and tortilla.  The veggies were vibrant (though the broccoli florets not the best color) and retained a nice crispness.  The plantains sweet and fat, though the firm sort rather than the softer more caramelized type that I personally prefer.

They also had a soup available, though it was not mentioned anywhere on the menu posted at the market.  So it might be worth asking about it if that's what you are interested in.

My friend really wanted to ride the tram as we were going around town like tourists. When we tried to look up information on the tram, there wasn't too much that we found online that was helpful for tourists (i.e, does it matter which end we board on?). Luckily, we decided to board at the bottom because apparently you can't board at the top (i think?). 

It only costs $4.35 for a roundtrip ticket. The views going up were spectacular and breathtaking. It was fun going over the freeway and watching the cars zip on by. We took a couple of pictures at the top and then headed down. Literally in and out in less than 30 minutes. 

I do wish there was a little bit more for tourists to do (or at least more information posted on what tourists can do while visiting the tram), but understandably it's a mode of transportation to and from the different OSHU sites for patients and hospital staff.

I have been to Temple only once (so far). Many of my friends go often and insist its great. They offer a free meal to those in need or those who can appreciate the sort of community love and humanity that they provide in doing so. Being a hard-working, but often 'broke' individual I ventured over to see what it was about.
The Temple itself is externally gorgeous. In fact so cool, my friend and I went for a stroll around before the dinner service (7pm, every weekday). Apparently we ventured a little too far around and were shouted at by a member of the Temple for "nosing around". My bad. This made for an awkward point when time came to get fed haha. 
There are rules. 
- Wash your hands immediately upon entry. 
- Talk as little as possible. You are there to eat.
- Finish all of your food. Seconds are ok, but finish those completely as well.
All said and done. I enjoyed myself and will make more treks out.
The food was honest and simple. I dig that.

I've actually been here a few times on the way to make trips. Better than the duty free inside the airport. Here is a PSA....please do not spray the perfume in the air when others are around. Some people are sensitive to perfume....don't be that asshole please. When I call you out on being that asshole please don't look at me and pretend you don't speak English when I heard you speaking English clearly a few minutes ago. Seems to always happen when I am here. It's common sense, don't spray when there are others around. I actually saw one lady take a perfume out of the box and try to make that her tester....really? Comedy and rage aside, this is actually a very decent duty free shop. I don't drink or smoke, therefore, nothing here means anything to me other than the really large Toblerone that's a tradition to eat on each trip. The prices are duty free, however, with the Canadian dollar lately it's not really much of a savings. It's great if you're an international flyer and want to bring something over, however, State to Canada and vice versa it's not worth it price wise. If you need that much Vodka maybe you shouldn't be flying at all.

Hey our two veggie rolls were really good! Ordered the rolls and gave them phone # to text when done. Ordered two draft beers at the crooked can. Found a table outside as text arrived. Large delicious veggie rolls were actually a little too large. As others here have noted, sushi or in this case rolls should really be "bite size."  These were really ginormous and awkward for one bite. Two bites made a mess. So we tried both attacks, had fun with it and enjoyed a perfect sunny Sunday afternoon.

I heard about this clinic from this Yelp... that's why I set up an appointment to see Dr Kriesel. I had to drive 1 hour and go through downtown Austin to be here. So I was late for 30 mins. The lady at the front desk told me that they have to re-schedule me for next month. I said, oooh crap. I had to talk to the Clinic supervisor had me schedule for the following Monday. 
First time appointment no consideration whatsoever which pisses me the hell off. Screw this ARC. And the front desk clerk, Dr's RN rolled their eyes on me like a disease.

I don't know anything about cars and I just moved to Roslindale.  When my car needed a decent amount of work a couple months ago (brakes, muffler, A/C) I took it to the closest shop right down the street from my house.  BIG mistake.  Less than 2 months later and my brakes were completely shot.  That's when I came on yelp looking for a better place.  I brought my car to Auto Depot and Frank called me less than 24 hours later explaining exactly what was wrong (as expected, they did an incomplete job at place #1) and saying my car would be ready by the end of the day.  I will definitely use Auto Depot in the future.

I love Down Under Yoga. It can get pretty packed, but I've learned that most studios can. The instructors at Down Under are all welcoming and provide great cues and corrections. The heated flow classes are challenging, but leave you feeling brand new afterwards. Most classes I've taken were led by Claire or Gregor. Both are fantastic and keep you motivated throughout the session. If you want to take a yoga class that pushes you, but leaves you feeling rejuvenated, go to Down Under! The heated flow classes can get verrrry warm - I've found that some classes feel warmer/tougher than others, but haven't found a pattern to figure out why. For anyone wanting to come here before work, the studio has showers, but from what I recall, you have to bring your own towel and toiletries. Namaste!

I am a big fan of Walpole Outdoors - both the quality of their products and their customer service. It's a local business that manufactures regionally and employs staff - not work through independent contractors or day laborers.
I've purchased and installed Walpole's wood mailbox post (and mailbox) and wood fence (Chilmark). The quality of the wood and the craftsmanship is simply amazing. Looking out the window (or pulling in to the house) and admiring it and thinking about my decision to go with it brings smile every time, every day.
As with such superior product, quality installation, and company with high standard and customer service, it's going to cost more than Home Depot or random fence installer you find on Craigslist. However, good fence should last 15 years and you're going to be looking at it every single day. How often do you drive by the neighborhood and see fence falling part or panels missing? IMHO, it'll be well worth your money and energy to do it right and have access to customer service to reach out to if you have questions or issues later. Good luck finding and reaching the guy you hired through Home Depot.
 
Once I called for a consultation and a quote, they promptly scheduled a visit and the sale representative (Barry) came over for a measurement and thoroughly went over the options and pricing. Barry didn't pressure me and was very courteous and professional. Anytime I had questions, I could email Barry and get his response quickly. Installers came over on a scheduled date and completed the installation the same day. They were also friendly and professional and didn't leave any mess behind. I was very satisfied with the result.
 
After couple of months later, I decided to expand the fence. Having had such great experience with Walpole, I simply emailed Barry with my desire to expand. He came over and gave me another quote and scheduled the work. I was not home when the installation was completed. Few days later, I noticed that small section of the fence was off color and had blemish. I took couple of pictures and sent it over to Barry and informed him that it wasn't up to expected quality and asked if they can take care of it. Couple of days later, while at work, I received a call from Walpole saying they are coming over and will replace the entire panel. When I came home from work, the work was complete and I had a brand-new panel. I didn't have to demand or threaten for Walpole to go above and beyond to make me happy. I was floored by their customer service

Their policy for not replacing coffee mugs is very silly. I figured that at least the mugs would get cleaned by housekeeping since they aren't replaced, but they never cleaned the mugs so we had dirty coffee mugs for the next morning. The lack of privacy in the bathroom is also bothersome, and the shower "door" isn't wide enough so every time we showered the floor around the toilet was flooded. And I would prefer to have an actual phone in the room instead of the Alexa knock off. Not everyone has jumped on the voice activated band wagon. But the bed is comfy, room was quiet and the hotel is in a great location.

Second time in and no better this time. The first one we sat outside and thought we had poor service and that contributed so we didn't leave a review. Second time we come in, sit inside and had the same experience! Clearly known locals are treated well by the owners with everyone else being upright  ignored.  Had a Chile rellano and what literally tasted like canned refried beans (which they said were fresh) and undercooked Rice. Overall, it was bland and swimming In extra oil- tasteless. My husband had the carne asada over a salad and we both though the meat tasted off- to which the waiter (owner's son) repeatedly disagreed and said how fresh their meat was.. totally absurd and rude considering we were trying to be polite and still pay for the dishes. It was just quite honestly awful.

Dr. Mangione treated me for a very serious issue.  He was very stern insisting that I get a scan under general anesthesia, which I didn't want to do.  Thank goodness he was so insistent.  The consequences could have been much worse if the issue went unchecked.  I am not looking for a friendly guy with lots of free time to chit-chat.  He is an excellent medical professional.  He's not extraordinarily warm-and-fuzzy but that is totally irrelevant to my choice of gastro doctors.

Ever thought about going skydiving, but questioned the idea of waiting for a parachute to open and keep you from plummeting to the ground?  Well hang gliding is just as adventurous without the worries of a parachute malfunction.

The crew at Wallaby Ranch is extremely inviting. Upon arrival, you will quickly realize that the staff and regulars that hang around the ranch are extremely laid back.  However laid back they may be when hanging out, they are completely professional when prepping you for flight and throughout your soar time.

Obviously we dont have any jumping off points for launch, so at Wallaby they use ultra-light airplanes to tow the gliders up to a couple thousand feet.  Once the satisfactory altitude is reached, the pull of a single cord sets you free and you begin soaring like a bird over the Florida terrain.

I have gone skydiving, para-sailing, and para-gliding and I have to say that hang gliding offers the most free feeling.  Your flight time lasts for 10-15 minutes - depending on how daring you want to be with your flight path.

Be sure to go early in the morning as the thermals pick up later in the day and can make the flights a little rough.  Besides that, after they finish taking everybody up for the morning flights, they invite everyone who hangs over to their outdoor kitchen and serve up a huge buffet-style breakfast.  The food isnt too shabby and the conversation is charming.

If you are looking for something fun and interesting to do, take flight with Wallaby Ranch!

A most delightful person to deal with. I highly recommend.

 Jan was willing to do a small project addressing invitations for me and was also able to squeeze-in a couple of last-minute "whoops" invitations a week later, on the spot.  So, if you are like me, and have a couple of last minute additions to your mailing list, she can do it.  She will charge a rush-fee, but it is completely reasonable.  
She will also stuff the envelolpes and mail them for you.  

Couldn't have been easier, and I have gotten nothing but great reviews from the people who received the invitations.

She has more than enough absolutely beautiful writing styles to choose from.  Her style varies from traditional to contemporary, so you should find something you like.  She can also make-up a custom style to match your invitations!

Absolutely use this woman.  She is lovely to deal with and very reasonably priced.

Gotta say very professional and very cool to deal with. Fantastic work absolutely. Brought my BMW wheels to get refinished and one to be repaired. Had a previous shop fix it and what and abomination. Highly recommend them if you need your wheels repaired or need them to look like new

Our project was very complex and took three months to complete.  It turned out better than the original design which had to be abandoned due to a difficulty in joining the new construction to the old.  This challenge cost us more money and Steve and his crew more work.  But they solved the problem and we love the result. Here's what I think makes this company stand out: Steve, the owner, is a really good guy and honest.  His foreman, Noe, is an excellent carpenter and does quality work. Right at the start Steve told us that he would not consider the project done until we were totally happy with it.  And he kept his promise! The reason I haven't given 5 stars is that the construction crew repeatedly left their food trash all over the property, and even in front of my neighbor's place.  I had to go around and pick it up to keep my dog from getting to it, etc.  Also I hope Steve can upgrade his software because as the project went over budget by about 11% it was difficult for us to follow his numbers.  This is because his statements didn't clearly show the credits for what we had removed from the project and how the extra costs were accounted for. Because of this both parties had to spend extra time and effort.  One final word of advice: go for the hidden screw option if you're doing a deck.  It is SO worth it and looks terrific!

Reserved a pontoon boat in the midst of COVID restrictions. A great way to get outdoors and safely socially distance. As our day approached, the weather changed. We called to check if we could switch days and they were quick to let us know we could. Perfect.

Check-in was smooth. We were provided a quick training and we were off. We rented for the day and took advantage of exploring the Columbia river. Pontoon Boat was in great shape and had a larger engine so we were able to make decent time to get out to the gorge. It was a gorgeous day and we couldn't have been happier.

Highly recommend, but plan ahead (we attempted to rent on another occasion and they were booked).

This is an incredible resource for people who love their 4-legged companions and are looking for a safer, and I believe more effective, alternative to surgery. Danyel and her team were amazing from the start and worked with us to get our little girl was back out and hiking. Now we're about 8 months out and Sukha's leg is strong and healthy and she is even working her way back out of the brace. We are so grateful. Thank you Danyel and Walking Paws Rehab!

This is BEYOND 5 stars worth of family fun and adult adventures wrapped into one Awesome evening you will not soon forget! My family recently enjoyed the 4th of July event of a lifetime! Live music, patriotic popsicles for the young'ns, horseshoes & other outdoor games and yummy foods and treats! My favorite part was the spectacular fireworks show!! Granted the place was sold out but the fact that the owners Sarah & Chris are soo down to Earth...it still managed to feel intimate and personal! Yay for a new playground, swimming pool, and recreation center!! 

So glad this place was remodeled and it looks better than ever! But then again i don't know what it looked like before, except for that it was under construction for a while. Worth the wait! 

This place has a little bit of everything for everyone and a ages. What i like the most about this is that the playground is shaded. Florida doesn't play with its heat and humidity so this is what every playground should have! 

The pool has a little splash area for the kids, my son approves and absolutely loves it. They offer classes here as well, just check at the front desk for the information and times. This review is long overdue!  A&BPS has been caring for our pets for a year and a half!  

I consider our pets as family, so it is extremely important that I know they are in good hands.  I never have to worry with this amazing team.  

Dog Walking - We have regularly scheduled visits for our pup.  We have had a few different walkers over time and all have been amazing!  They truly enjoy what they do and show a genuine interest in the well being of our pets.  We are especially lucky to have Keith caring for our dog now.  Benny loves him (and I'm pretty sure Keith loves Benny too!).  I occasionally work from home but still keep the walking routine for our pup.  I have never seen Benny get so excited about going on a walk (he doesn't get that excited with me!).  This warms my heart.  I know that while I'm working, Keith is taking good care of Benny.  He even gives some attention to our cat (she's not one to let you get away without a few pets).  He leaves me a note about the walk, how Benny was and that he refreshed his water for him). Cat Care - When we travel, we have A&BPS feed our cat and refresh her litter.  After each visit, we always get a photo of her and their visit. I reached out to them for desperate help and they reacted immediately, shuffled schedules around and made everything work out.  The company name says it all!  They go above and beyond in everything they do.  Thank you Ted, Holly, Keith and the entire team.  You guys rock!

Nothing but a positive and painless experience. 
My #2 molar broke and could not be crowned or capped. Fortunately (glass 1/2 full)  my wisdom tooth next to it was extracted decades ago so loosing this molar will have no effect in regards to 'shifting' of my teeth. 
I do not have dental insurance but I understand they're running a business and although I had a bit of sticker shock I did get a 5% discount (paying in cash) and Ashley at the front desk was very empathetic and I appreciate her understanding and ability to listen. 
After having my consult I felt completely at ease. Both the oral surgery nurse and Dr Auzins were very thorough. I really had no questions or concerns because they were addressed by them. Their office had to be in touch with my PCP because of a medication I'm on and they were on it. They contacted me several times just to make sure all the t's were crossed and i's dotted. Fast forward to the morning of the extraction. Although I was given a pre-op med to relax me before hand I did not need it and that's because of the confidence I felt about them after the consult and their obvious concern in regards to the med I referred to earlier. I did not feel at all nervous. Upon my arrival I was immediately escorted back and we got started. The nurses were very professional and friendly. There was no dilly dallying which I feel is important. Dr Auzins came in and administered the versed which I highly recommend. It took a few minutes for the versed to kick in, Dr Auzins returned and the tooth was pulled. It was completely painless and quick. My appointment was scheduled for 7:50am and because I live close I was home by 9:15. Not bad. I took 2 pain pills the first day and have needed none today! I feel great. Another thing I really appreciated is that Dr Auzins called me the evening my my procedure just to see how I was doing. 
No one wants to lose a tooth but if you do this is the place to go. I highly recommend Dr Auzins and the entire staff.

When I travel to other cities, I try to visit a local masjid to pray, learn and socialize. Atlanta Masjid of Al-Islam ranks tops on my list for "welcoming masajids."
This masjid has the true "Southern hospitality" that makes one feel right at home. Smiles, warm greetings, and loving hugs are the norm here. The Muslim community follows the philosophy of Imam W.Deen Mohammed, so there is a progressive atmosphere. The cultural mix is predominantly African -American, and you're sure to see Muslimahs wearing colorful expressions of modesty. Outside the masjid there is a pop-up shopping area, where you can purchase clothing, books, paintings, cut-up fruit, handmade items and bean pie after Friday prayer.
I love this masjid, my husband (an Imam in a northern city)loves it, my children and grandchildren love it - there is something here for everyone to enjoy!

This place is really neat, if you want to work on your car, but don't have the tools or a lift, go here! They have manuals to all different types of cars, a nice garage space for you to work, and people to help you out. They also do window tinting, that includes a lifetime warranty as long as you own the vehicle. Me and my mom brought her truck here to get tinted (we did not use the garage for any repairs, so I'm just going by what I seen). A guy named Pito did the tint, and did a fantastic job, I would recommend him to anyone. 407-956-9469 is his number. Quick, quality service at a good price. The place is kinda hard to font, its behind "Road Runners Tires" with a little side driveway, if you are coming from 192, it would be before you get to Road Runners, but if you are coming from the opposite direction, its right after. This place is definitely worth trying out.

I consulted a handful of attorneys before moving forward with Mr. Carrasco.  Based on what I had learned in those consults I knew I needed counsel that was confident in complex issues. I didn't want someone to hold my hand, I needed someone to represent my best interest and that of my children aggressively and who wasn't afraid of trial if it came to that. 
Mr. Carrasco actively kept me in the loop with anything related to my case, answered all of my many questions promptly and sometimes on the occasional weekend (accessibility was super important to me). I would whole-heartedly recommend Ben, his expertise got me through an extremely difficult situation and his dedication to the end result I wanted was unwavering.

Harvard square is a place with great and unique food establishments... none of which were displayed on this tour. This tour was not advertised as 21+, therefore I sat idly during the beer tasting. Next we went to Fire + Ice, a chain that is much too expensive for college students. Here we ate a tiny plate of little fried things that we dipped in our choice of sauces intended for stir fry. This was advertised as the "food." Next, we were brought to Berry Line, which has AMAZING frozen yogurt, but I felt pretty insulted when all I received was a free sample cup of each flavor. 

I would like to point out that the tour guide was PHENOMENAL and truly knowledgeable and did the best with what she had. Not to mention, no one had shown up for the earlier tour for which I waited half an hour. Unfortunately there had been some type of emergency, but it is the owner's responsibility to inform tour participants of the tour's cancellation. 

I do believe that this tour can be improved, and think it is a great idea. I just find it wrong to take people's money for a tour that us still vey much in the works.

Oxygen is NOT overrated! Dr. Nason performed several procedures to improve my airways. He, the surgery center staff, and his office staff went above and beyond to ensure I made an informed decision and felt comfortable with the procedure. In a time when most medical appointments are handled by PA's or busy doctors on a 10 minute rotation, Dr. Nason was at every appointment, even the post-op check-ups. He was always, personable and engaging. Additionally, I've never waited more than 10 minutes to be seen.  As a bonus, the staff at both offices are kind and caring. I never, ever write reviews - in fact, this is my first one - but I would be remiss if I didn't take an opportunity to extoll their virtues.

I am in the insurance industry and found myself with black water toilet leak in master bathroom.   We have tile everywhere and had no idea the toilet was leaking.  I called Kennedy Restoration and have been treated like a QUEEN!   They have gone above and beyond any contractor I have ever hired.  We have a huge amount of tile that needed to be removed and replaced.  Nathan, Aaron and Faye and the cleaning team have gone above and beyond!!!   The tile contractor has done a beautiful job!!!   I will post my before and after as soon as it's completed.  We are almost done!!!   Beautiful and perfection is all I can say.  The most professional group of folks I have ever dealt with!   Everyone so considerate and respectful with masks during Covid.

We were here during the week of July 4th for our summer vacation, and was surprised by husband with breakfast with the princesses at Cinderella's Castle for myself, mom and daughter. The staff were super polite, but not the kind where you know they are just trying too hard. Every table gets a dish of blueberry Muffins, croissants and strawberries.We order the filet, quiche, and scrambled eggs with bacon and sausage. I must say everything was Delish! I was in shock that it was, and when back in town will definitely make reservations here again!

I asked Farzam from SurfZone Engineering to come out and evaluate if my foundation was structurally sound enough to do a dig out. The report I received detailed his thoughts and he also pointed out other areas I should look at. I especially appreciated the additional information. The report was thorough, easy to comprehend and arrived in my inbox merely a few hours after he came to our house. 

I wasn't home when Farzam came out but my wife said he was extremely professional and personable. I would definitely recommend Surf Zone.

Do not use this company if you need a tow and have an expensive car or one you'd hate to see damaged! 
They throw drivers in off the street with limited training, who will damage your car due to a lack of experience (note driver admitted to this!) and\or to working long hours! 
I believe in giving 2nd chances; however, after stating they would take care of the damages to my car as the driver admitted to the mistake\damage, they have since screened all calls and emails regarding the cost to repair the damage. 
Their business practices need work as well as their drivers knowledge of how to properly tow vehicles, if requesting tow from AAA, you have the right to request another company.

After reading the raving reviews about this show, I figured it could make a good girls night out. Honestly I didn't know what to expect. Nevertheless is was a good time and something different to do.

The location is Gilt Night Club formerly known as Roxy's. Parking is $5.00 and is self parking.

The show: the show itself was OK in my opinion. I have seen magic Mike so I guess I was hoping to see some of those dance moves :) 
The change of costumes in the show was good.
You can interact with the performer but at  cost. You can purchase the passes at the door or before the show and they give you spot on stage and of course a private dance with the performers

The night we picked to go was a combination of bachelorette parties, birthday parties and divorce parties (yes apparently there are people who celebrate divorces) so it was very crowded. You can tell all the women in the club were enjoying the show.
Make sure you bring a lot of cash to tip the dancers and the bartenders.

Lived in a PMT property for a long time now. Service was always mediocre but I never needed much. I'm now on year 5 in the same place and starting back in July my apartment developed a fruit fly issue. I didn't do anything to cause this and did everything I could do to resolve the issue. It took months before they would even come help. Nothing seemed to work and communication was a huge issue. Now it's March and I still have fruit flies. The issue died down during winter. I hoped it was a permanent state, but they came back whenever it warmed up, my apartment manager and the building manager don't listen or email me back about it. My surrounding neighbors are having the same issue. None of us know what to do and PMT isn't helping to resolve the issue. It's been months without returned communications.

I love how this campus is by PDX airport and is in somewhat walking distance to the stores and theMax line. Not too much of a hassle driving from Vancouver, but traffic gets jammed packed on the freeway heading back to Vancouver around 3:30pm. I am just starting my PN program here, the staff is friendly and will assist the students in anyway possible, I was impressed. Oooo their RN program is cheaper than Breckenridge down the street and they explain the program(s) information a lot better than Breckenridge ever did.

To say that WSL is a sect is absurd hyperbole.  It shows a complete lack of understanding of what the Waldorf philosophy is all about and what the word "sect" actually means.  WSL is completely non-denominational and ALL religions are represented, taught and respected.  The curriculum is in fact secular although Rudolph Steiner was Christian.  Staff, administration, teachers, and families come from a wide range of religions and nationalities (over 35!).  My children have attended this school for 5 years (and Waldorf schools all of their lives) and we have been more than pleased with the playful, caring, rigorous, and expansive education they have been receiving.  In addition, they are media-free.  If you're concerned about the effects of media on children, especially these days as it is effecting children in all sorts of unhealthy ways (depression, anxiety, etc.), there is NO other school that understands the research and data better and no school that keeps it out of the classroom (and most families keep it out of their homes).  I have worked in media and technology for over 20 years and I send my kids to a Waldorf school. So do the executives in Silicon Valley!  That says a lot!

NOTE: In Fall, 2017, the school added BUS service in Cambridge and Arlington.  If transportation was your only inhibitor, know that you can now get your kids to WSL easily in the mornings!  Part of the mission of the bus is also to improve socio-economic and racial diversity at the school, since it is dedicated to this mission, and the school offers financial assistance.  If you're at all interested, please visit their website, attend an Open House, or contact Kate in the Admission Officer to schedule a tour.  You'll be glad you did!

Mary Ann and Daniel are nothing short of extraordinary in my opinion.  I hired Mary Ann after interviewing three other attorneys.  I can't tell you why I selected her but I just felt she would do the best job and she didn't disappoint. I got a pretty serious traffic citation that she agreed to take on.  The prosecutor assigned to the case was less than willing to work with us on reducing the charge or giving us the lower end of a serious citation. They appeared to want to impose the strongest possible penalties for what was at the lowest end of a serious infraction.  So with Mary Ann's recommendation we decided to go to trial.  Mary Ann got straight to work filing briefs and representing my rights.  When we showed up to set a trial date the prosecutor had a change of mind and decided it would be best to dismiss the charge and defer a speeding ticket conviction provided no driving offenses over the next six months.   It was totally amazing to see how they changed their tune once Mary Ann started showing that the case would not be open and shut.  I can only tell you that you should NOT underestimate the importance of hiring the best attorney.  Being a nice guy, being honest, and telling the truth only emboldened the prosecutor to give me the WORST outcome as they felt they had an open and shut case.  Thank goodness I hired the best and I am honestly in debt to Mary Ann and Daniel for their hard work. Thanks Mary Ann and Daniel.

This isn't a franchise. It's an old (1992) place - you'd pass it and never go in from the looks on the outside. Old and unassuming. Only the locals know about this place. 
The steaks are the absolute best - Argentine cuts. I love the steak Empana ($26/meal). They have an old grill out back for the yummy steaks, they serve a green salsa with the home made bread that's delicious, and if you like wine, they have the best. 
You're greeted at the door by the owner (he gives us a hug leaving). They're not in a rush - take plenty of time if you're going. Owner and server (usually just one) really care about your meal, if you like it, if you want anything else - a real mom and pop place. 
There's never very many people there - about 7-8 tables inside, larger outdoor area (for larger groups).

I purchased a new Garrett Apex, and when available, they shipped promptly.  The machine ended up being defective, however since I just got it, I wanted to make an exchange for another.  KellyCo was of no service and would not help me.  They said I needed to contact Garrett.  I asked about their 30 day no hassel returns, and they said that doesnt work for defective products and there was nothing they would do.  I feel their advertising and customer satisfaction is misleading.  I wont be buying from them again.    Garrett, however took charge and made me happy.

Our company rented this place out for a corporate event and this was so much fun! They set up tables for us and we had food and beverages. They played really cool music. The bathrooms were super duper clean and modern. The employees were really chill and attentive. Everyone took the time to explain the rules and the coaches were super cool when showing us newbies how to throw. We had the funnest tournament, lots of laughs and now a love for throwing axes. All in all it was a great night.

Dont ever order delivery from these guys. It was raining so i ordered from them, after a full hour they still havent arrived, so I called them and the lady on the phone barely spoke english for one thing, but secondly when I ask whats happening with the food, she said its been waiting for the driver. So i told her, that means the food is now cold because its been just sitting there, and her respond was "Yep. it will be".

thats it, no apologies, no nothing. then she actually told me that NEXT TIME, call them to find out where the food is, as if its my responsibility to track down the delivery rather than expecting it to be delivered within a reasonable time; not to mention she actually thinks there will be a next time. 

Took me ages to get my money back. Oh yeah, get this they are 5 blocks from my house on the same street and she just made some lie up and said there was bad traffic when I can look out my window and see there is no traffic.

I started going to Amy's Baber Shop several months ago.  Previously I went to a sports branded chain barber shop that was always crowded.  

Amy's Barber Shop reminds me of the local barbershop that I used go to in my hometown to get my haircut when I was a kid.  She has 3 chairs, but I think that Amy is the only barber (she has a girl cut women's hair on Thursdays).  Amy is usually there along with her dog Sadie (the best dog in the world, who is very friendly, loves kids and will usually jump in your lap and want to be petted).

I think I will probably get my hair cut here from now on

NOTES: Women's haircuts only on Thursdays; Amy's Barbershop is cash only

I don't usually write reviews on yelp. I made this for the sole sake of the great experience I had with this store. I walked in knowing very little about, well honestly anything. I left with not only the product I needed but also alot of knowledge about how to grow and clone,  etc which the guy at the desk, Eli, had no obligation to show me for free. He even did a hands on demo of cloning a plant for me. Eli is incredibly friendly and helpful and I left the store feeling great and immensely satisfied. They do not always have everything in store that is on their site, but they always have good if not better alternatives available and the prices are very fair.

These guys are great. They always work with me to make sure I get what I need and they beat everyone else's prices. Just today I had called ahead to let them know I was coming and when I did not arrive when I said I would be there the business owner personally called me to check on me. I am always greeted with a smile when I go here. They treat their employees like family and their employees treat you like your family.

Susan is the lawyer you want on your side, I can't say enough about her professional, kind and straight forward approach to dealing with my legal matter. With over 40 years experience in her field, she knew exactly how to deal with my situation and recommended the quickest AND most cost effective solution. I see that someone rated their experience differently but that is not what I experienced and you don't get a great reputation like hers (several people referred her to me due to their great experience with her) without exemplifying an honest attorney. She and her staff are stellar in approach, trouble shooting, execution and relationship (she knows all the courts, judges, law changes, etc. around adoption). Highly recommend her

These guys take care of 80% of the work for us parents. I thought they just taught the kids how to put on their equipment, do a 'pie' & 'French fries'. I was good with just that! However, they teach them so much more. They have an awesome team learning how to go down hills while lifting their skis. They show them the stance for good posture. Kids learn to hike around obstacles and also to carry their gear! All I have to do is prepare her for blizzards and have hot cocoa ready.

Would not recommend purchasing from them. Go elsewhere and experience better customer service. Very disappointed after spending 3k. 
Purchased a quality grill and smoker from them. Was not delivered at promised date; which was before 4th of July.  Delivered a faulty grill without an instruction booklet 2 weeks later causing us to miss 4th of July.  Was told that sales person gave instructions at purchase. They delivered a replacement( after we had to call to remind them a week later) that was not the same grill as we paid for, but of lesser quality that was not stainless or natural gas. They did not bother to look up original sales ticket invoice to know what was purchased.
Returned all purchased items for refund.

As I walked in the door, an overwhelming stench hit me in the face. It was absolutely disgusting. 
The guy working was on the phone, offering some medical advice over the phone, (pretty sure that's illegal since he isn't a veterinarian) and called the guy on the phone an idiot after hanging up.
